p.t: A New Life in the Sun: Where Are They Now? [NEW]
p.d: In Spain, cycle tour operators Zoe and Mark take a ride into the unknown. In France, an awful year for retreat operator Sue threatens a decade-long adventure. And on the Costa del Sol, have Rachel and Lee still got their taste for pies?

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: Simon O'Brien and Henry Cole head to Buckinghamshire, where their restorations include a pair of manhole covers, a water pump and a beehive.

Across Europe, there are hundreds of remote villages, hamlets, borgos, and cortijos lying empty and unloved. Following the intrepid Brits who have spotted an opportunity to breathe new life into these abandoned houses.
Jo and Darrell from south-west London are looking for a holiday home in Menorca. For their £300,000, Danni Menzies is on hand to show them five great properties in the south of the island.

Laura Hamilton helps sailing enthusiasts Barbara and her daughter-in-law Jodi search for a holiday home that their family can enjoy on the Balearic island of Mallorca, famous for lively resorts, secluded coves and beaches and beautiful countryside.
Julie and Paul are searching for a holiday home in Tarragona, Spain, where they can completely relax and switch off. Leah Charles-King shows them what their budget of £100,000 can buy.

In Cheltenham, the first to host is 46-year-old Belgian-born hotel consultant Oli Delaunoy. Oli plans to wow his guests with his posh scallop starter and meaty main, but it's his loud and vivacious personality he's banking on.

It's the second day of the competition in Cheltenham and the turn of glamorous nurse Jan Blomer to host. Jan hopes to impress with her good honest home cooking, chicken with sun dried tomatoes for her main and home-made ice cream for dessert.
Third to host in Cheltenham is super competitive events director and body building fanatic Zak Roby. Zak cooks Thai 'Tian of Crab' served with fashionable micro herbs and a duo of duck main.

It is the fourth day of the competition in Cheltenham and the turn of Aussie admin assistant Kimberley Thomas. She aims for a sophisticated evening, and hopes to impress with her meaty starter of pork belly and apple salad and her pie main course.

It's the final day of the competition in Cheltenham, and the turn of stay-at-home dad Paddy Castledine to host. Paddy plans to walk away with the prize by serving a simple menu with quality ingredients.

Four pairs of bed and breakfast owners put their reputations on the line by staying at each other's establishments. They pay only what they deem to be an acceptable amount or the experience, with one establishment being named as the best value.

Craig Rowe is house-hunting in the southern French city of Carcassonne with Sue and Tony, in search of a holiday bolthole for their budget of £100,000. This isn't their first viewing trip to the area, there's already a property on their radar.

"The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors.

College graduate Molly (Louise Smith), trying to bankroll her own business, works as a high-priced New York City escort. As a lesbian, she's able to keep her emotional distance from the clients, who range from cynically exploitative to desperately needy. But her open ambition to rise above her current station rubs many of her coworkers the wrong way, especially the combative, street-smart Dawn (Amanda Goodwin) and the escort service's disdainful madam, Lucy (Ellen McElduff).
In the 1960s, a group of teen pranksters finds it difficult to toe the line in a strictly disciplined Catholic school.

In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other.

Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past.

Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood.

In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn.

Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

p.t: El niño con la cara de mi hijo
p.d: Una mujer ve la fotografía de un niño que es idéntico a su hijo fallecido, solo que mayor y vivo. En busca de respuestas, descubre información sobre engaños y secretos que involucran a personas en las que alguna vez confió.

El esposo de una mujer desaparece mientras navegaba en kayak y todos asumen que se ahogó, pero, cuando ella ve a un hombre idéntico a él, desencadena una serie de acontecimientos que revelan cosas sobre su marido que ella desconocía.
Un asesino en serie escapa de prisión y aterra a un criminólogo retirado.

El bebé de una mujer es diagnosticado con un raro trastorno genético, ahora ella se apresura a encontrar un donante, descubriendo una red de engaños que la lleva de regreso a la clínica de fertilidad donde concibieron a su hijo.

Angie es una mujer exitosa que tiene una clínica de tratamientos de belleza y chatea en línea con Max, un supuesto médico. A pesar de las advertencias de sus amigos, ella sigue adelante con la relación, pero puede estar cayendo en una trampa.

Investigación sobre el asesinato de JonBenét Ramsey, una niña de 6 años, reina de la belleza, a quien golpearon y asfixiaron. Su cadáver fue hallado en el sótano de la vivienda familiar un 26 de diciembre de 1996.
Una chica atormentada por horribles pesadillas, logra finalmente recordar la desagradable manera en que murió su hermana.

Stacey recibe una llamada accidental de su esposo, Jeff, escuchando la muerte de una mujer durante esa comunicación. Más tarde, su esposo llega a casa y le dice que perdió su teléfono, lo que hace dudar a Stacey.

Un prestigioso actor interpreta un monólogo en un teatro sobre la vida de Pepe Guindo, un músico anciano y fracasado. Durante la representación, afloran los recuerdos agridulces del músico intercalados con las impresiones del actor.
Jacinto en sus tiempos fue matador de toros, ahora vive miserablemente con su sobrino y tiene nuevamente la oportunidad de torear.

Dos periodistas investigan a los Grupos Antiterroristas de Liberación, un escuadrón financiado por el gobierno de España que vivió un conflicto con la organización terrorista Vasca ETA a mediados de los años ochenta.

La madurez se acerca para Isabel al mismo tiempo que su marido la abandona para irse con una chica más joven. Pero aunque todo el mundo espera que su vida sea equilibrada, ella no está dispuesta a dejar pasar algunas aventuras.
Tres amigos de la infancia vuelven a encontrarse después de muchos años. Surge así un triángulo compuesto por el sexo, el amor y la protagonista.
Un grupo de jóvenes entra en la embajada de Cuba en Madrid justo cuando Fidel Castro anuncia en la televisión las primeras elecciones democráticas.
Desesperado por un poco de efectivo, un agitador político (Eduard Fernández) planea secuestrar a un senador (Jorge Perugorría) en la Habana.

Al enviudar, Pedro se vuelve a casar con Beatriz, viuda también. Su nuevo matrimonio resulta ser un infierno, por lo que planea envenenar a su esposa y quedarse con su secretaria, Carlota. Por su lado, su nueva esposa también planea matarlo.
La historia de dos amigas que son barrenderas y cuyas vidas cambiarán después de un encuentro inesperado.
Dos hombres ayudan a Sofía a convertirse en la mejor chef del mundo.

Fer es un enamoradizo publicista veterano quien, tras divorciarse, anhela la tranquilidad y eludir así la ajetreada vida en la ciudad. Por ello, decide viajar a Menorca, invitado por su amigo Miguel Ángel a un retiro idílico. Sin embargo, la mujer de Miguel Ángel ha llevado a más familiares de los esperados, por lo que Fer deberá quedarse en casa de Nuria, una atractiva escultora antisistema que vive en un conflicto continuo con su hija.

Hoping to expose corruption, radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. Their cause soon gets hijacked by an extremist within their ranks who's ready to kill everyone. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother.

p.t: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
p.d: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever.

p.t: Mom and Dad Save the World
p.d: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife.

Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji.

Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of inspectors are on a mission in 2003 to find Iraq's reported stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction. Traveling from one dangerous site to another, Miller and his team fail to find any chemical agents or other weapons. Instead, they discover an elaborate cover-up in which the most-elusive weapon is truth.

In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn.

Stacy Hamilton (Jennifer Jason Leigh) is a pretty, but inexperienced, teen interested in dating. Given advice by her uninhibited friend, Linda Barrett (Phoebe Cates), Stacy gets trapped in a love triangle with nice guy Mark Ratner (Brian Backer) and his more assured buddy Mike Damone (Robert Romanus). Meanwhile, Stacy's classmate Jeff Spicoli (Sean Penn), who lives for surfing and being stoned, faces off against Mr. Hand (Ray Walston), a strict teacher who has no time for the slacker's antics.

The new owner of the Cleveland Indians, former showgirl Rachel Phelps (Margaret Whitton), has a sweetheart deal to move the team to Miami. But to break the lease with the city of Cleveland, ticket sales have to plummet. So Phelps hires the most incompetent players available, including near-blind pitcher Ricky Vaughn (Charlie Sheen) and injury-prone catcher Jake Taylor (Tom Berenger). But her villainous tactics accidentally foster a can-do team spirit, turning the Indians into potential winners.

The Cleveland Indians, an endearing assortment of oddballs who improbably won the division championship last season, have since lost their edge due to personal pursuits and the excesses of fame. Rick Wild Thing Vaughn (Charlie Sheen) does lucrative endorsements, but his killer fastball is gone, while once-aggressive slugger Pedro Cerrano (Dennis Haysbert) has become a laid-back Buddhist. But, as the players realize they've all gone astray, they rally for a shot at the World Series.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

Capitol police officer John Cale has just been denied his dream job of protecting President James Sawyer as a member of the Secret Service. Not wanting to disappoint his young daughter with the bad news, Cale takes her on a tour of the White House. While he and his daughter are there, a heavily armed paramilitary group attacks and seizes control. As the nation's government dissolves in chaos, only Cale can save his daughter, the president and the country.
The grassland of the Serengeti is home to herbivores in Africa.
The influence that insects and their relatives have on the planet's ecosystems; the landscape the grasslands of South America is created by insects.
Borneo is the richest rainforest island of all; home to 40,000 species of plants and animals, 6,000 of them are unique, and more are discovered almost daily.

Dating coach Alex "Hitch" Hitchens (Will Smith) mentors a bumbling client, Albert (Kevin James), who hopes to win the heart of the glamorous Allegra Cole (Amber Valletta). While Albert makes progress, Hitchens faces his own romantic setbacks when proven techniques fail to work on Sara Melas (Eva Mendes), a tabloid reporter digging for dirt on Allegra Cole's love life. When Sara discovers Hitchens' connection to Albert -- now Allegra's boyfriend -- it threatens to destroy both relationships.
Charlie has second thoughts after setting Alan up with their new neighbor (guest star Brooke Shields).
Charlie must face his feelings when Rose announces she is moving to London; Alan fudges his online dating profile, only to wind up with a fellow profile-embellisher.
A more mature woman helps rebuild Charlie's ego after he becomes insecure about his age.
Evelyn makes Charlie and Alan regret saying that she will not have any mourners at her funeral.

Alan prepares Jake for Judith's wedding; Charlie continues his fling with Herb's sister.
Alan's friendship with a gay single dad prompts both Alan and Charlie to re-examine their sexual identities.
Jake has a windfall when Charlie takes him to the track; Alan finds himself stuck at the Department of Motor Vehicles.

Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

When Ella discovers the Help Center has fallen into disrepair, she talks Curtis into lending the church money from their savings to fix it up; the couple soon butt heads over the fastest way to get their money back.
Someone breaks into Curtis' food truck, and a much-loved family heirloom, an old Hokie pot used to make his father's special sauce, is stolen.
Everyone is excited for Malik when he finally gets a good-paying job, until they find out it's for a weed dispensary; Malik tries to educate them on all the benefits of marijuana as a medicinal drug.

When CJ brings home a new drone for the fire department, it is stolen in what he believes to be a burglary; to ward off any further intrusions, CJ installs a high-tech home security system with audiovisual capabilities.
Curtis wants to build his Sauce Boss brand and Ella needs to get women to register for the church's help center to receive a much-needed grant.

When Curtis throws a fit about all the money he and Ella are spending, he implements drastic cost-cutting measures; things backfire when Ella follows his direction and begins cutting back on the things he enjoys.
Calvin and Miranda enter the world of hysterical parenting when Christian is having problems at school; they find out he is bullying which brings to the forefront their own tempers and issues.

After Glo exchanges harsh words with Curtis she gives him 210lbs of pork that a butcher-friend gave her; Curtis is suspicious of the gesture and begins piecing together an unlikely tale of matricide and cannibalism.
Malik steps into his destiny when he gets the opportunity to campaign across Georgia for issues in the state; he hires Sauce Bosses as the official food truck and becomes Curtis' boss.
Curtis suspects his food truck was blown up intentionally, and he starts investigating the incident; Calvin must get to the bottom of Calvin Jr.'s mischievous deeds.

p.t: The First Lady of BMF: The Tonesa Welch Story
p.d: Detroit native Tonesa Welch rises from teen mom to drug dealer in a harrowing story of riches, remorse, personal responsibility and redemption amid the lavishness and extreme violence of Detroit's crack era.

Jeremy rushes into the kitchen because of an emergency; Leah and Phillip learn it's not an emergency at all; Jeremy has his first gray hair; in order to prove he still has his youth, Jeremy challenges Phillip to a race.

Phillip fixes Vinny's hearing aid; but when Vinny puts the hearing aids on, he realizes he can hear loud and clear, Vinny overhears the conversation and comes to the conclusion that Leah and Jeremy killed Reginald.
The Pleasant Days crew worries about Vinny's libertine lifestyle of drinking, smoking, poor diet and no exercise; he's not as young as he used to be, so they want him to clean up his act.
The way the residents have been behaving disgusts Cora: not cleaning up after themselves, bickering over the television, leaving the toilet seat up, and using foul language.
With the assisted living facility not proving profitable and Sandra preparing to go off to college, Jeremy reassesses the family's financial future.

Anastasia's first ex-husband contacts her for the first time in decades, but Anastasia shows no interest since she never forgave him for what he did to her in the past; the other residents push her to meet with him.
Phillip tells Jeremy he wants to play lacrosse; Jeremy realizes he needs to study the sport to help his son get ready for tryouts.

Serie de caricaturas animada basada en el programa mexicano de los años 70 de situaciones cómicas, que por el contrario tenía personas reales y que ha sido una de las series más vistas en los países hispanohablantes, la cual fue muy popular entre grandes y chicos de varias generaciones. Este programa se centra en las vicisitudes del Chavo, un niño de 8 años, huérfano quien vive en una vecindad. Cada personaje tiene unas características muy peculiares y aunque se generan malos entendidos entre ellos, los cuales son muy divertidos, existe un sentimiento fraternal mutuo. Algunos de los personajes de los niños son: el Quico, la Chilindrina, Ñoño, el Chavo y la Popis. Una característica del programa es que no se define exactamente la vivienda de el Chavo, el niño se esconde en un barril de madera ubicado casi a la entrada de la vecindad.

p.t: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
p.d: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one of the most sensational cases of their careers after a cop stumbles upon a dazed and bloodied young man walking down the road. Accused of murder, the suspect claims demonic possession as his defense, forcing the Warrens into a supernatural inquiry unlike anything they've ever seen before.
A priest is constantly interrupted by grandma's cellphone; a little girl gets her tongue stuck in a car trunk; a baby creates a big mess when changing its diaper!
Uncontrollable laughter causes the whole waiting line to laugh; a street chef makes sandwiches using his dirty sandal; a royal guard's hat filled with confetti takes everybody by surprise!

There's no sound, but there sure are plenty of laughs. This crazy Quebec-based troupe uses the city as its stage, and its inhabitants, or victims, as characters! People are caught in a twisted yet funny web of comedic deception. This updated "Candid Camera" is a tad more risque and a little kookier with its practical jokes. The little snippets last only a few minutes, and some look more painful than others.

Julie va bientôt avoir 30 ans et sa vie est un véritable chaos. Elle a gâché son talent et son ami plus âgé Aksel, un dessinateur à succès, veut qu'ils fondent une famille. Un soir, alors que Julie se faufile à une fête, elle fait la connaissance d'Eivind, un homme plus jeune et plus charmant. Elle se sépare d'Aksel et se lance dans une nouvelle relation dans l'espoir d'une nouvelle perspective de vie. Mais elle doit se rendre à l'évidence : certains choix de vie sont déjà derrière elle.
Fin de la programmation.
Fantomini veut récupérer sa voix volée par un crapaud joueur de tours; de son côté, Doulou veut aider Monsieur Yéti à préparer un atelier pour des petits koalas qui visiteront bientôt l'Himalaya.
Ginger et les petits Pois-Rex aident un jeune Maïspopus à grimper tout en haut du volcan, là où la chaleur fera éclater ses grains, lui permettant alors de muer.
Tillie a planifié une soirée d'activités avec ses monstro-gardiens, mais quand une panne de courant survient, elle doit changer ses plans et s'amuser sans électricité.

p.t: La Pat' Patrouille: histoires de chiots [NEW]
p.d: Monsieur Hellinger met en place des situations d'urgence afin que ses chatons volent la vedette à la Pat' Patrouille; monsieur et madame Wingnut adoptent une autruche et la perdent aussitôt.
Après la pluie, Léon joue avec une flaque d'eau.
Alors qu'il a persuadé son père de lui confier la mission de livrer une baguette magique à la Sorcière, Pinocchio se laisse entraîner par ses camarades dans des blagues potaches.
Au parc national du Serengeti, durant la plus grande migration de mammifères au monde, Arthur L'aventurier et sa guide Siyana partent à la rencontre d'animaux tels que le lion, le zèbre et le gnou.

MacTrapp capture un kangourou rouge pour son zoo grâce à son boomerang magnétique super puissant; alors que le trappeur rencontre quelques difficultés avec l'animal, l'équipe tente de surmonter le piège créé par le gadget de MacTrapp.

Spencer Spendington, propriétaire de zoo et homme à la fortune colossale, propose un poste en or à Liz ; cependant, cet or sent le trafic d'animaux, et plus particulièrement d'une espèce en voie de disparition : les lions blancs de Tanzanie.

Om Nom rencontre un petit cochon et décide de se joindre à lui pour jouer au ballon; comme d'habitude, rien ne se passe comme prévu et ils finissent tous les deux dans les égouts, où ils rencontrent un inconnu inattendu.
Gabriel Lobe invite Jean dans son monde virtuel afin qu'il relève son défi ; si Jean perd, il devra libérer Lobe de la console de jeu dans laquelle il est retenu prisonnier.

Bibi fait une vidéo en direct au Chahuta pour passer en revue le menu. Mais quand elle ne reçoit pas assez de J'aime, Twister, déguisé, se fait passer pour un client, ce que les gens abonnés à Bibi adorent. Elle va tout faire pour démasquer le mystérieux convive!
Tetsuo doit récupérer un oeuf en or dans un nid.

La presión lleva al límite a veinte celebridades que enfrentan los más exigentes desafíos ante un equipo de expertos. Solo uno recibirá el título de Top Chef VIP y el premio de 200 mil dólares.
Natasha busca al hombre que mató a su hermano y decide casarse con él para vengarse, sin imaginar que su plan tomaría otro rumbo. Una modelo es víctima de activistas fuera de control.
Paola ayuda a chicos con tendencias suicidas, pero Jefri casi muere presuntamente incitado por ella. Para comprobar la infidelidad de su marido le pone pegamento y picapica a los condones.
Jairo sufre un derrame cerebral y al salir del coma tiene una nueva orientación sexual. Consume unos hongos que le provocan alucinaciones y, al otro día, despierta con el clítoris mutilado.
El hijo de Carolina y Hugo es sordo, ella lo inscribe en clases de actuación, pero a escondidas del padre. También, Elizabeth sale del ejército y se obsesiona con la comida militar.
July le paga a Santiago para que tramite su proceso migratorio, pero él se gasta el dinero y no hace nada. Accede a tener un trío con otro hombre y ahora su esposa está embarazada del invitado.
La hija de Karen, menor de edad, es fanática de los tatuajes, pero sufre serios daños al hacerse uno en el brazo. Melisa le inyecta a su abuelo su propia sangre porque él quiere rejuvenecer.
Carlos pierde la esperanza de jugar fútbol profesional cuando un borracho le parte una pierna. Dos años después, el destino le pone en su vida a la persona que lo ayudará a levantarse.

Mayra encuentra una bolita en los ganglios de su hijo Santiago. Acude al médico y las noticias no son alentadoras, pero su hijo no deja de sonreír. Un linfoma cambia sus vidas y le demuestra que los milagros existen.
Jay pasa dos años en prisión por un accidente que provocó su novia, pero ella lo culpa a él. Además, Yosaida usa jengibre como estimulante sexual con su pareja, pero se enferma gravemente.
Ana pone la casa a nombre de su hijo para que demuestre solvencia económica, ahora él quiere desalojarla y ella lo demanda. Jorge exige que su pareja lo deje ser el padre adoptivo de su hija.
Mohamed conoce a una posible nueva esposa, Latifa no se queda tranquila a la espera. La policía busca a Paula y a Fernando, Natalia se ve salpicada, Marisa no quiere que haya escándalo.
Albieri quiere reconocimiento, Leonardo quiere a su hijo, Lucas le pide ayuda a Enrique y lo pone en un difícil dilema. Daniel y Natalia conversan. Jade recibe su collar, Said tiene preguntas.

Un músico viajero se ve atrapado en medio de una guerra entre dos narcotraficantes en un pueblo mexicano fronterizo.
Dos amigos realizan negocios ilegales desde su automóvil, hasta que el pasado y la policía los hace recapacitar.

Alfredo, un poderoso hombre que vive en un rancho, es enviado por su padre a la capital. Allí conoce a Fabiola, una mujer ahogada en deudas familiares que lo seduce para sacarle dinero. Sin embargo, para conseguirlo deberá aceptar una invitación al rancho, donde Alfredo descubre sus intenciones y le da una lección.

Una hermosa mujer sigue recordando a su gran amor, pero la vida le trae otro hombre. Cuando se enamora de él, rompe la promesa que le hizo: Conservar su trenza. En el pueblo una serie de milagros ocurren, que son atribuidos a la trenza.

Mickey Jones es un músico rebelde que conoce a Laura Pacheco, una despampanante latina de un barrio de Los Ángeles. Sus destinos han quedado entrelazados, pero su turbio pasado amenaza con destruir todo lo que aman.

La ceguera generada por un accidente de auto deja a Jonás totalmente fuera del juego. A pesar de su resistencia a aceptar esta nueva condición y a mostrarse vulnerable ante sus hijas y esposa, las circunstancias lo llevan a descubrir otros caminos.

p.t: Nosotros, mi papá y el perro
p.d: Sebastián es despedido de su trabajo e intenta recuperar el control de una vida que parece haber perdido hace mucho tiempo. Justo cuando la tarea de poner todo en orden se siente imposible, su hermano llega exigiendo parte de la herencia y resurgen viejos resentimientos familiares.

En la Nueva York de la década de 1950, dos adolescentes de orígenes étnicos distintos se enamoran. Su romance alimenta el odio entre los Jets y los Sharks, dos pandillas rivales que se disputan el dominio de las calles del barrio.

Junior es un niño venezolano de 9 años que tiene el pelo obstinadamente rizado. Él se lo quiere alisar para la foto de su escuela, con el propósito de parecerse a un cantante de moda. Sin embargo, a su madre le parece una idea aberrante.

p.t: Irene, yo y mi otro yo
p.d: Charlie es un policía experimentado con doble personalidad: una gentil y otra indeseable que emerge cuando no toma su medicación. Sus dos yos se enamoran de la misma mujer, a quien debe escoltar desde Rhode Island hasta Nueva York.
Rosa está a punto de cumplir 45 y se da cuenta de que siempre ha vivido para los demás. Cuando decide dejarlo todo atrás, toma el control de su vida para cumplir su sueño de empezar un nuevo negocio.
Una joven, con sueños de convertirse en compositora de éxito, presenta su trabajo en un bullicioso bar de Nueva York.

Ofelia es una joven impetuosa que forma parte de las personas de confianza de la reina Gertrudis en el palacio de Elsinor. Su personalidad no pasa desapercibida ante los ojos del príncipe Hamlet, a quien conquista rápidamente. Después del asesinato del rey, el príncipe se ve desbordado por una sed implacable de venganza, y Ofelia deberá contener a las altas esferas del poder danés.

p.t: La gran aventura de los Lunnis y el libro mágico
p.d: La fantasía está en peligro. El malvado Crudo ha descubierto la forma de terminar con el Libro Mágico, que contiene todas las historias inventadas por la humanidad. Una niña de 9 años es la elegida para salvarla con la ayuda de sus amigos los Lunnis.
Unos adorables perros comienzan a influir en las carreras, las amistades y los romances de una presentadora, un paseador, un empresario y otras personas de Los Ángeles.

Fer y Lucía se encuentran casualmente en un paradero de autobuses. Las circunstancias las obligan a convivir y pasar dos noches juntas en un paisaje que les es por completo ajeno, confrontando sus realidades, sus deseos y sus sueños.

La familia Garibaldi, sumida en problemas económicos, hereda el edificio La Maravilla, un lugar tan hermoso como mal conservado. Por si esto fuera poco, sus nuevos vecinos tienen tantos o más problemas que ellos.

Un hombre mayor e indocumentado y su nuera tendrán que buscar una nueva vida, luego de perder a uno de sus seres más preciados.

Un hombre mexicano (Adam Jacobo) se muda a los Estados Unidos para reunir dinero y comprarse una casa.

Tres amigos utilizan su talento musical para escapar de la dura realidad de su barrio.

On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story.

p.t: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
p.d: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of inspectors are on a mission in 2003 to find Iraq's reported stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction. Traveling from one dangerous site to another, Miller and his team fail to find any chemical agents or other weapons. Instead, they discover an elaborate cover-up in which the most-elusive weapon is truth.

The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

Everyone deserves a great love story, but for 17-year-old Simon Spier, it's a little more complicated. He hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing.
A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.

In this dark comedy, the crotchety Willie (Billy Bob Thornton) and his partner (Tony Cox) reunite once a year for a holiday con. Posing as a mall Santa and his elf, they rip off shopping outlets on Christmas Eve. This year, however, Willie is falling apart. He's depressed and alcoholic, and his erratic behavior draws the suspicion of mall security (Bernie Mac). But when befriending a small boy brings out his kinder side, Willie begins to wonder if there is still some hope for him.

Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior.
La coincidencia, la intervención divina y el destino unen a varias personas durante un día intenso que se convierte en una odisea moral.

p.t: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
p.d: Godzilla y Kong se enfrentan a una amenaza colosal escondida en lo profundo del planeta, desafiando su propia existencia y la supervivencia de la raza humana.

Un oficial del Ejército y su equipo de inspectores se enfrentan a un elaborado plan mientras buscan armas de destrucción masiva en Iraq. Su misión no tiene resultados positivos, pero encuentran algo inesperado.
Durante el transcurso de su servicio, Megan y Rex completaron más de 100 misiones hasta que una explosión les hirió, poniendo su destino en peligro.
Un adolescente homosexual se enamora a través de Internet de un compañero de clase cuya identidad desconoce. Averiguar de quién se trata resultará una experiencia divertida, ardua y trascendental.

Un hombre que lava dinero para la mafia rusa pide a una pareja inglesa que está de vacaciones en Marruecos que entregue información a un agente del MI6, el servicio secreto británico. Asegura que va a delatar a muchos criminales para los que trabaja a cambio de asilo político en el Reino Unido.

Separadas y decepcionadas con la vida adulta, las Bellas se reúnen de nuevo y están listas para dar la nota, y meter la pata, en una competición europea donde descubren que deberán usar mucho más que sus voces para vencer a sus rivales.

Dos criminales tienen como costumbre el disfrazarse de San Nicolás y de duende para robar tiendas durante las celebraciones navideñas. Sin embargo, este año, uno de ellos se siente desmotivado, deprimido y abatido. Puede que esto sea el principio de un importante cambio en su forma de vida.

Dos criminales, el malhablado, alcohólico, Willie Soke, y su compañero Marcus, conspiran, con la ayuda de la malhumorada madre de Willie, para estafar a una organización benéfica durante la noche de Navidad.

p.t: Hainan, China: El misterio de la selva
p.d: La selva, un mundo lleno de vida, misterio, majestuosas montañas, cascadas, fragancia, exuberancia y cantos de innumerables criaturas. Las etnias Li y Miao también han vivido en la selva generación tras generación y crecen entre las melodías encantadoras de la selva. Tejen sus vidas artísticas con el sustento de la selva. La selva nutre a todas las criaturas que coexisten en armonía. Todo es hijo de esta selva.

Is one of America's most prolific uncaught serial killers still alive, and will a new $50,000 reward finally help collar the sadistic criminal? Now known as the Golden State Killer and responsible for at least 12 murders in California, the man investigators have sought for 40 years may be linked to another series of unsolved crimes, raising a key to perhaps solving the case. This five-part docuseries is an in-depth look at the manhunt, patterns, escape methods and mind games of the killer. It also includes interviews with investigators, law enforcement and victims, who offer information to help solve the mystery of a man who has managed to escape justice for decades.

The show's episodes follow each case from the initial investigation until it reaches its legal resolution.

The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash.

The investigative documentary series "Mysteries Decoded" delves deep into some of America's greatest unsolved mysteries, exploring newly discovered evidence and utilizing high-tech tools in each case. From Area 51 to the Salem witch trials, each episode's investigation is coordinated by Jennifer Marshall, an accomplished U.S. Navy veteran turned top-notch private investigator, as she mobilizes her team to embark on the formidable quest to bring closure to these long-lingering historical puzzles.

p.t: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
p.d: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

Now a fugitive, Hunt recruits brilliant hacker Luther Stickell (Ving Rhames) and maverick pilot Franz Krieger (Jean Reno) to help him sneak into a heavily guarded CIA building to retrieve a confidential computer file that will prove his innocence.

Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent.

The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people.

Un dúo busca recursos cerca de un lago y encuentran una sorpresa. Al estar cerca el final, todos deben elegir el mejor momento para acercarse al punto de extracción. Además, todos están exhaustos y uno sucumbe al cansancio.
Ed soporta la ceremonia de las hormigas bala, lo más doloroso después del parto. Lo acompañan en estas 24 horas de agonía unos jóvenes brasileños, que lo hacen 20 veces para convertirse en hombres.
Un supervivencialista de "Supervivencia al Desnudo" entra en conflicto con el grupo mientras aumentan las pistas sobre la identidad de la Serpiente.

Los participantes pasan por el incómodo momento de encontrarse con sus compañeros. Los problemas empiezan el primer día: casi ninguna pareja puede conseguir agua potable o montar un refugio y uno de los participantes ya piensa en darse por vencido.

Algunos supervivientes priorizan la construcción del refugio, otros la búsqueda de una fuente segura de agua. Empiezan a aparecer los primeros conflictos personales y se revela una dificultad inesperada: la región está infestada de garrapatas.

Bill es duro con sus camionetas, en particular con su camioneta de carreras F-150, y está listo para ponerla en acción una vez más. El equipo diseña una suspensión única en su tipo para un camión de remolque de 1952.

Bill pensaba que ya lo había hecho todo, hasta que llega un Ford Lightning y se convierte en el primer Air Ride personalizado de Ekstensive, con un tren motor totalmente eléctrico. El equipo trabaja en un camión de remolque clásico del 52.

Bill ve una oportunidad única para convertir un Jeep Gladiator 2022 destrozado en una camioneta personalizada. La escena de los vehículos todoterreno ha explotado en Texas, y Ekstensive tiene la oportunidad de mostrar lo que tienen.

Bill vuelve a construir minicamiones de carga con una Polaris Ranger y le instala una casa rodante personalizada y una caja que "salta". Ekstensive ha construido muchos vehículos desde cero, pero nada como el camión de remolque del 52.

Jamie battles searing pain and a deadly infection after the stingray attack. Malu and Mandy struggle with Ana Lis' survival priorities. All of the camps finally meet and combine their map pieces for rescue. Two survivalists are removed from the challenge.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: As spring tornado season rolls into Father's Day weekend, a rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states. Witnesses scramble for safety as a deadly EF3 cuts power and silences tornado sirens.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: In March 2025, thousands of eyewitnesses capture disaster at their doorsteps as extreme atmospheric volatility unleashes a massive Texas haboob and more than 150 tornadoes across the southern states, devastating towns and homesteads in their path.

When Jerry Jr. learns that legendary chef Guy Fieri has bought a used Apocalypse Hellfire truck at an auction, he offers Guy free customization; Frank locks in a deal to build a custom Overland truck for internet superstar Nick The Wrangler Bishop.

On the midseason premiere, Tickle and Carol open their new restaurant while Tickle contends with conflicting priorities; Mark and Digger enlist Amanda to improve their wildly popular hazelnut rum; Josh shocks his outlaw partners.
A drunk man dressed like a giant baby refuses to let Shawn tow his car; a frightening find spooks Pineapple; during a call at a haunted house, the tow truck driver is terrified.

The ladies of Vegas give the tow truck drivers a run for their money when Pineapple fends off a bevy of bachelorettes in a bus; Kyle encounters a showgirl; Shawn faces off with Goliath and scores are settled between the tow companies.

The crazies on the Strip keep the tow bros busy; TW goes toe-to-toe with an angry Elvis, and Jeremy contends with salty strip club clients while Pineapple senses déjà vu in a trucker's lot; Elmer is sent on a fool's errand.

At a call on the Strip, tow truck driver Shawn is shocked by a six-foot python in a car's front seat; TW tangles with a motel customer twice his size; when a gun is pulled, Elmer races to rescue a fellow driver in danger; a driver's window is smashed.

Pineapple argues with a woman who has a hall pass from her husband; Jeremy gets in a fight, and Elmer hunts for a massive haul; TW's easy tow turns into an ordeal, while a crazy customer goes ballistic on Bridgett; Shawn makes a spooky discovery.

When a drug dog alerts a vehicle full of clubbers heading to a techno bar, officers find the group has gotten creative with their illicit drugs; officers inspecting a couple's truck find bags full of rat carcasses to be used in a specialty soup.

When an older couple crossing into the US has cartel logos on their packed clothes, they have some explaining to do; a Mexican driver says he's visiting a friend in Texas, but seems nervous; a vehicle search finds evidence of hidden compartments.

When a trailer full of sea salt shows up at the bridge, officers decide to inspect it; the bags do contain a crystalline substance, and it's an illicit one; during an inspection of a U.S. citizen, something illegal rolls out of his pocket.

A speaker cabinet is found to be carrying more than just sweet beats; a driver who took a wrong turn and ended up at the border crossing is packing more than he should be; following a recent smuggling trend, officers carry out a special operation.

Officers examine a trailer filled with cooking supplies and unearth a GPS tracker, the kind cartels use to watch their loads; US citizens who accidentally approach the international border are inspected, and it turns out they have a few secrets.

Destacados comediantes presentan hilarantes rutinas de 8 minutos en distintos formatos y abarcando numerosas manifestaciones del humor.

La serie de situaciones cómicas mexicana, se centra en una familia conformada por Ludovico, protagonizado por Eugenio Derbez, quien es la cabeza de la familia, su esposa, Federica (Consuelo Duval), y sus tres hijos, Junior (Luis Manuel Ávila), Bibi (Regina Blandón) y Ludoviquito (Miguel Pérez). Ellos viven en una ciudad muy particular, la cual está edificada con peluche y todos los accesorios son de peluche también. Ellos son una familia común y corriente que enfrentan problemas comunes, los cuales son representados en el programa de manera exagerada, los conflictos siempre terminan en situaciones divertidas. La comedia de humor original, ligera y única está dirigida para todo el público en general.

La serie ligera y divertida de situaciones cómicas producida por la cadena mexicana Televisa, relata las vidas de los habitantes de un edificio de apartamentos y sus relaciones entre ellos, se exploran los conflictos y sucesos divertidos que pueden pasar entre vecinos al tener que vivir cercanamente con gente que tiene personalidades diferentes. Durante cada episodio de 60 minutos se tocan temas en la trama del programa como la envidia, la ambición, el egoísmo, la solidaridad y en general desarrolla temas que pasan a diario en la vida de un ser común. Su creador Eugenio Derbez, también participa como actor y comediante en la serie, junto a él también participan César Bono como Frankie Rivers, Eduardo España como Germán Martínez, Macaria como Magdalena Pérez y Polo Ortín como Don Roque Balboa, entre otros.

Paco es un cuarentón divorciado que se enloquece con las jovencitas y vive con su hijo Fran, un veinteañero con debilidad por las cuarentonas. La única que no parece estar de acuerdo es Rocío, la exesposa y madre.
El Vítor y Albertano, los galanes del barrio, tienen que pagar la renta de su apartamento, pero no encuentran trabajo y hacen muchas locuras con tal de tener un techo digno.

For decades, Hooters was one of the most celebrated restaurant chains in America, cementing their place in pop culture with their iconic owl logo and scantily clad "Hooters Girls". But as the restaurant reached its peak in the 2000s, a series of young women working at Hooters - including an aspiring model, a newlywed, and a young mother - were targeted by predators and murdered in cold blood.

In 2003, supermodel Tyra Banks broke into the world of reality TV; ANTM offered women from all over the country the promise of fame and fortune, but the aspiring models soon realize they may be collateral damage on the show's path to popularity.

As ANTM becomes more popular, it pulls in more seemingly vulnerable girls; some hopeful contestants claim they were treated increasingly poorly, leading to allegations of lasting trauma from what they endured on the show.

America loved Bob Barker, but few knew about the scandal behind the scenes at The Price is Right; former employees break decades of silence, exposing a hidden affair and secrets that reveal a darker side of television's most beloved game show icon.

Bob Barker retaliates against model Holly Hallstrom after she refuses to testify on his behalf, triggering a decade-long legal war; as mass firings and new allegations surface, Barker's power is exposed and the women who stood up are finally heard.
The one and only Lauren Graham drops by to join Joey, Lance and Melissa for coffee, eggs and all things brunch.
USA's Everything on the Menu host Braun Strowman stops by to enjoy a flavor explosion on Cocktail Wars, and we find out what the strongest human we know thinks about our menu.

Our mixology expert, Melissa Brooke, takes us back to the basics with a series of challenges meant to test our mixologists' skills, while Lance and Joey bring along an old friend to join the fun - actor, producer and writer Seth Green.

Josie Geller, a baby-faced junior copywriter at the Chicago Sun-Times, must pose as a student at her former high school to research contemporary teenage culture. With the help of her brother, Rob, Josie infiltrates the inner circle of the most popular clique on campus. But she hits a major snag in her investigation -- not to mention her own failed love life -- when she falls for her dreamy English teacher, Sam Coulson.

Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss. She can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.

Después de recibir apasionados besos con los ojos vendados de dos misteriosas bellezas durante el desafío "Beso secreto", los isleños deben decidir si quieren conocer a los recién llegados a la villa levantando la mano en secreto.
Como muchos están sorprendidos por el resultado de la reconciliación, surgen conversaciones intensas sobre sentimientos heridos.
Se revela un secreto que sorprende a uno de los isleños, todos en la villa juegan una ronda de "Llegar a la cuarta base."
Joshua, recién en forma, lleva a Govind a dar un paseo salvaje en el parque. El entrenador personal Nathan rinde homenaje a su película favorita de los 80 y lleva a Haley a una cita perfecta.

Hannah y Joy se llevan muy bien y la temperatura aumenta, aunque no exactamente como Hannah esperaba. El modelo de peluquería y vegano Devin intenta imponerle su estilo de vida a la antigua reina de la belleza Lauryn, pero ella no se deja.
Kourtney se siente devastada porque Scott ha presentado a los niños a su novia, pese a que ella se lo prohibió. La familia pretende redimirse participando en el programa "Celebrity Family Feud".
Kim prepara el nacimiento de su tercer hijo mientras Khloé tiene problemas para encontrar al padrino adecuado para su bebé. Kourtney, por su parte, debuta bailando en un flash mob.

Ariana y Katie se reúnen con Randall para invertir en su tienda de sándwiches, mientras que Sandoval se acobarda al ayudar a Brock con su último plan para casarse con Scheana. La pandilla se dirige al norte a una hermosa bodega en Santa Ynez.

En la víspera de la fiesta de compromiso de Raquel y James, Scheana y Brock hacen un gran anuncio que conmociona a su grupo de amigos, y Sandoval confronta a Lisa por su falta de apoyo al nuevo bar de los Tom.
Una mirada a las nuevas maneras en las que es posible enamorarse.

Esta vez el médico se transforma en paciente, porque el doctor Nassif está gravemente enfermo. Además, los doctores tratan a una mujer que tiene los pechos muy deformados.

La información que se debe saber antes de que abran los mercados en toda Europa. Un análisis de lo que no está disponible en ningún otro lugar, las historias más importantes del día e invitados expertos en el tema bursátil.

Un programa que se centra en las políticas formadas por la Administración del presidente Donald Trump.

Se conocen los platillos y los paisajes de Jalpan de Serra, Querétaro. Allí preparan michecaña, nieves de guayabillo y cecina ahumada de manera artesanal. También se conoce la zona arqueológica de Tancama y el mirador Los Chacos.
Felicitas Pizarro muestra todo acerca de la entraña y arañita. Los dos cortes clásicos con un sabor único.

Alex Ruiz prepara un pescado zarandeado al estilo de la costa de Nayarit y unas langostas al mojo de ajo, con las que el chef preparará unos tacos de langosta con mantequilla y frijoles al estilo Baja California.

Sergio Camacho lleva a los Petersen a probar la torta de chilaquil. En el centro de la ciudad, disfrutan de una llamativa torta antes de ir a ver las luchas libres. Luego, disfrutan de deliciosos tacos al pastor, volcanes y gringas.

La Cofradía de la Nécora de Noja, en Cantabria, organiza un evento multitudinario alrededor de un manjar que se puede elaborar de mil maneras. De la oveja lacha sale uno de los quesos más prestigiosos de España.

Álex Ruiz enseña a preparar el famoso cóctel Acapulco: camarones, pulpo, cebolla morada y limón son, entre otros, algunos de sus ingredientes. Luego, cocina caguamanta: un caldo de mariscos con manta y pescados del Pacífico.

Tupac llega a Río Negro y conoce a un productor de vermut con hierbas silvestres en Dina Huapi. En Bariloche, conoce a un chef que lo invita a cocinar conejo, y visita el Cerro Campanario y un ahumadero.
Cómo hacer un steak porter house delicioso que combina perfectamente con una guarnición de coliflor al carbón.
Una visita a los más remotos parajes en busca de los tesoros culinarios de cada región. Los platos que se transmiten de generación en generación, preparados por los lugareños en sus propios fogones.
Poncho Cadena prueba unos deliciosos tacos en Tacos Rigo, en Cancún. En Campeche, visita la taquería de Norma Ruelas. En Mérida, visita la taquería Kisin.
Verónica visita la ciudad fronteriza de Tecate para conocer a Toñita, una abuela de 101 años que rebosa vitalidad y buena sazón. Junto a ella, aprende la receta de las exquisitas empanadas de carne.
Se prepara un chorizo envuelto cocinado a la parrilla y al horno de barro. Y de postre una deliciosa cake de chocolate.
Alejandro enseña a preparar dos clásicos de la comida callejera: unos deliciosos tacos de comal rellenos de chile y picadillo, y una variación del clásico elote que se vende en los parques de México.
Luciano va en la búsqueda del erizo rojo, un producto muy protagonista para la preparación del ceviche. Allí, verá también cómo es la recolección de algas.
Dos recetas ideales para el menú diario: cochinita pibil y ensalada de habas.

Based on a story by famed science fiction writer Philip K. Dick, "Minority Report" is an action-detective thriller set in Washington D.C. in 2054, where police utilize a psychic technology to arrest and convict murderers before they commit their crime. Tom Cruise plays the head of this Precrime unit and is himself accused of the future murder of a man he hasn't even met.

In a future society, time-travel exists, but it's only available to those with the means to pay for it on the black market. When the mob wants to eliminate someone, it sends the target into the past, where a hit man known as a looper lies in wait to finish the job. Joe (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) is one such hired gun, and he does his job well -- until the day his bosses decide to "close the loop" and send Joe's future self (Bruce Willis) back in time to be killed.
A Secret Service agent must save his son and the daughter of a Supreme Court justice from armed terrorists.
A team of Navy SEALs quickly discovers it is facing a growing horde of zombies when it is sent into a city in Louisiana to find the vice president after contact is lost.

For Victor Rosa (John Leguizamo), that blunt world-view has come to define his life. A Latino hustler from the South Bronx, Victor has worked his way up the neighborhood ladder to become a crew leader for Joanna La Colombiana Menéndez (Isabella Rossellini). But after narrowly escaping an attempt on his life, Victor realizes that he needs to get out of the Bronx, both for himself and for his girlfriend, Carmen (Sônia Braga), the only thing more important to him than money.
Dave and Emma move into their dream house and are happy until violent thugs imprison them in their home while they search for a stash of heroin.
The search for her missing sister leads a woman (Erika Eleniak) to a vigilante leader (William Forsythe) who is working against a kidnapping ring.
A father fights to rescue his family from the undead when an attack destroys their survival compound.

A murder in Paris' Louvre Museum and cryptic clues in some of Leonardo da Vinci's most famous paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery. For 2,000 years a secret society closely guards information that -- should it come to light -- could rock the very foundations of Christianity.

When Harvard symbologist Robert Langdon discovers the resurgence of an ancient brotherhood known as the Illuminati, he flies to Rome to warn the Vatican, the Illuminati's most hated enemy. Joining forces with beautiful Italian scientist Vittoria Vetra, Langdon follows a centuries-old trail of ancient symbols in the hope of preventing the Illuminati's deadly plot against the Roman Catholic Church from coming to fruition.

p.t: Mujer, casos de la vida real
p.d: Esta serie conmovedora, que en el comienzo fue titulada solamente Casos de la Vida Real, ahora tiene añadido el sustantivo Mujer y como su título lo indica, realiza dos dramatizaciones por episodio de dos casos reales que le han sucedido a mujeres comunes. Estos casos son elegidos a través de miles de cartas enviadas por las televidentes a la programadora mexicana Televisa, la cual produce esta serie. Un equipo especializado selecciona los casos junto a la presentadora del programa, la gran actriz Silvia Pinal, los temas que se representan en el programa son temas de interés general que son censurados por la sociedad como: el incesto, la infidelidad, el aborto, la bigamia, entre otros. Al final se aconseja a las mujeres que viven situaciones similares el que pidan ayuda. Este programa de una hora también ha colaborado reuniendo hijos con sus madres o familiares que han estado alejados por muchos años.
Un programa que se da el lujo de hablar, sin censura, en primera persona.
Rubí es una mujer tan bella como lo es de perversa y su máximo sueño es encontrar a un hombre rico y conquistarlo con su hermosura, para que la saque de la pobreza a cualquier precio.

p.t: Tan cerca de ti, nace el amor
p.d: Verónica, marcada por haber entregado a su hija en adopción, cruza su destino con Joaquín. Sin embargo, la muerte de los padres adoptivos desata una red de secretos, traiciones y amores prohibidos que hacen que el pasado vuelva para exigir la verdad.
La relación entre una madre soltera y su hija se desmorona cuando ambas mujeres se enamoran del mismo hombre.

Este programa de una hora también ha colaborado reuniendo hijos con sus madres o familiares que han estado alejados por muchos años.

El título de esta serie proviene de la leyenda que al pedir un milagro a la Virgen de Guadalupe, se coloca una rosa al frente de la imagen y se le reza.

p.t: Lo mejor de Don Cheto al aire
p.d: Resumen de los mejores momentos de "Don Cheto Al Aire".
Jessica y Sophia deben tomar una decisión. Los médicos se preguntan si Aubrey está mentalmente preparada para su cirugía. Las damas disfrutan de una fiesta en la piscina, pero algo sucede.
Ariana Madix reúne a los participantes de la temporada 6 para hablar sobre los momentos más dramáticos de la temporada.

La presentadora Ariana Madix da la bienvenida al nuevo grupo de isleños, que han llegado a Fiyi en busca del amor verdadero. Los isleños participan en un juego de la diosa Fortuna, y se forman las primeras parejas oficiales.

Después de recibir apasionados besos con los ojos vendados de dos misteriosas bellezas durante el desafío "Beso secreto", los isleños deben decidir si quieren conocer a los recién llegados a la villa levantando la mano en secreto.
Como muchos están sorprendidos por el resultado de la reconciliación, surgen conversaciones intensas sobre sentimientos heridos.
Se revela un secreto que sorprende a uno de los isleños, todos en la villa juegan una ronda de "Llegar a la cuarta base."
Joshua, recién en forma, lleva a Govind a dar un paseo salvaje en el parque. El entrenador personal Nathan rinde homenaje a su película favorita de los 80 y lleva a Haley a una cita perfecta.

Hannah y Joy se llevan muy bien y la temperatura aumenta, aunque no exactamente como Hannah esperaba. El modelo de peluquería y vegano Devin intenta imponerle su estilo de vida a la antigua reina de la belleza Lauryn, pero ella no se deja.
Kourtney se siente devastada porque Scott ha presentado a los niños a su novia, pese a que ella se lo prohibió. La familia pretende redimirse participando en el programa "Celebrity Family Feud".
Kim prepara el nacimiento de su tercer hijo mientras Khloé tiene problemas para encontrar al padrino adecuado para su bebé. Kourtney, por su parte, debuta bailando en un flash mob.

Ariana y Katie se reúnen con Randall para invertir en su tienda de sándwiches, mientras que Sandoval se acobarda al ayudar a Brock con su último plan para casarse con Scheana. La pandilla se dirige al norte a una hermosa bodega en Santa Ynez.

En la víspera de la fiesta de compromiso de Raquel y James, Scheana y Brock hacen un gran anuncio que conmociona a su grupo de amigos, y Sandoval confronta a Lisa por su falta de apoyo al nuevo bar de los Tom.
Una mirada a las nuevas maneras en las que es posible enamorarse.

Los Brit organizan una jornada de puertas abiertas para su listado de $45 millones de Bel Air; la tensión aumenta cuando Flagg y Altman se enfrentan; Madison vende creativamente una casa de campo de Malibú; Flagg y Bobby se casan en Beverly Hills.
Esta vez el médico se transforma en paciente, porque el doctor Nassif está gravemente enfermo. Además, los doctores tratan a una mujer que tiene los pechos muy deformados.

El Dr. Stefan Stefanov, un cirujano respetado y querido, se ve envuelto en un escándalo tras la sospechosa muerte de un paciente. Una periodista emprende una investigación para averiguar qué ocurrió en realidad.
El disparo accidental de un arma de fuego arruina un viaje de caza en los bosques de Transilvania, en Rumania.
Un guía local recibe el encargo de conducir a un grupo de influencers por el río de un valle remoto. A medida que se adentran en la naturaleza, su aventura da un giro aterrador.
Tres jóvenes se embarcan en un viaje en barco por la costa del Mediterráneo, pero un escándalo en las redes sociales pronto pondrá a prueba su amistad.
Una extraña desaparición sorprende a un joven técnico enviado a los Alpes italianos para reparar una planta de energía averiada.
Matthieu Francoeur declara ante la policía la desaparición de su hijo y de su expareja, la madre del niño. Rebecca, teniente de la Brigada Juvenil, se encarga de investigar el caso.
Ursu, el profesor más severo de la universidad, descubre a Mo y su amiga Vera copiando en el examen. Ella le pide una segunda oportunidad y él se la concede: tendrá que visitarlo en su domicilio.
Una madre viaja a Cuba para impedir la boda de su hija, ya que piensa que está cometiendo un grave error. Pero sus planes pronto darán un giro inesperado.

Un hombre admite haber matado a su amado hijo sin dar explicación. Su abogado, decidido a descubrir la verdad, destapa oscuros secretos familiares y una inquietante conexión con una serie de asesinatos sin resolver.
La relación de un hombre con su mejor amiga se pone a prueba cuando ella se casa y él se ve obligado a enfrentar sus verdaderos sentimientos.

En 1989, cuando la Unión Soviética está a punto de derrumbarse, un grupo de estudiantes estonios se adentra en las montañas de Siberia, cerca de la frontera con Mongolia. Los diferentes orígenes y motivaciones del grupo desembocan en enfrentamientos.

p.d: Boris Pigovat: Por tanto, elige la vida. Sergei Rachmaninov: Rapsodia sobre un tema de Paganini. Igor Stravinsky: Petrushka. Juan Pérez Floristán y la Filarmónica de Israel, conducida por Lahav Shani. Auditorio Charles Bronfman, Tel Aviv. 2023.

En 1953, durante una gira, la amistad de los comediantes Oliver Hardy y Stan Laurel, los legendarios el Gordo y el Flaco, comienza a resquebrajarse al mismo tiempo que la salud de Oliver se deteriora.

Glen Powell en el thriller de acción distópico "The Running Man". La británica Rosamund Pike en "Now You See Me: Now You Don't". Jack Whitehall, protagonista de "Malice", y Ed Sheeran, que interpreta fragmentos de su álbum "Play".
En un breve relato, Norma desgrana sus sentimientos por artistas a los que no conoció, pero marcaron su vida de alguna manera.

After receiving his military discharge, Monty Brewster (Dennis O'Keefe) learns that his deceased uncle has left him $8 million -- with the odd stipulation that he must spend $1 million of it before noon of his 30th birthday. With two months before the day, Monty, who must also remain single and keep the terms secret, mystifies and then angers his fiancée, Peggy (Helen Walker), by postponing their wedding before discovering just how difficult it can be to spend a million dollars.
A cavalry major (Robert Stack) sides with Apache chief Cochise (John Hodiak) against Comanches after the Gadsden Purchase.

Mary Morstan has received a pearl in the post every year since her father's disappearance; when she is summoned to meet her mysterious benefactor, Holmes and Watson accompany her, leading to the truth about a secret pact.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Earp tries to help an old friend, Bat Masterson, who is working as an Army scout and being threatened by a killer.
A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

p.t: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
p.d: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Earp must defuse a conflict between warring families after Ollie and Mildred Taylor set up shop in Wichita and become targets of a man angry at Ollie's cousin for killing his brother; tensions escalate into a deadly struggle, then a lynch mob.
Paid programming.

p.t: International Fellowship of Christians and Jews

p.d: In this classic version of Theodore Dreiser's novel "An American Tragedy," George Eastman (Montgomery Clift), the nephew of a wealthy industrialist, is excluded from high society and given a blue-collar job at his uncle's factory. While ascending the ranks of the company, George becomes romantically involved with co-worker Alice Tripp (Shelley Winters). However, when he is introduced to socialite Angela Vickers (Elizabeth Taylor), he quickly falls for her, leading to a tragic love triangle.

In a French monastery during World War II, David Muldon almost drowned when he fell into a vat of brandy. Ever since, he has suffered from a psychosomatic response to alcohol that causes him to act inebriated if he so much as looks at a bottle of booze. Mary Belney, the psychoanalyst daughter of the senior partner of the big-ticket law firm David has just joined, attempts to cure his condition while he battles a city prosecutor on an eviction case.
Old West outlaw Bill Doolin (Randolph Scott) marries a deacon's wife, but his gang will not leave him alone.

There's a deficit of good, honest women in the West, and Roy Whitman (John McIntire) wants to change that. His solution is to bring a caravan of over 100 mail-order brides from Chicago to California. It will be a long, difficult and dangerous journey for the women. So Whitman hires hardened, cynical Buck Wyatt (Robert Taylor) to be their guide across the inhospitable frontier. But as disaster strikes on the trail, Buck just might discover that these women are stronger than he thinks.

Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protégé (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score.

New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.
When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

Young orphan Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back.

A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin.

The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work.

Amateur sleuth Nancy Drew (Emma Roberts) accompanies her father (Tate Donovan) on a business trip to Los Angeles and stumbles across evidence in the case of a movie star's long-unsolved death. The young heroine's resourcefulness and integrity are put to the test in the glamorous -- but sometimes treacherous -- world of Hollywood.

College is up next for a group of high-school friends, so Francesca (Scarlett Johansson), the most daring of the group, suggests they steal SAT questions in order to increase their odds of getting into good universities. Hoop star Desmond (Darius Miles), studly Kyle (Chris Evans), working-class Matty (Bryan Greenberg), stoner Roy (Leonardo Nam) and foxy Anna (Erika Christensen) sign on for the scheme. But getting into the test facility after hours proves trickier than any multiple-choice exam.

Chef Primo and businessman Secondo are immigrant brothers from Italy who open their dream restaurant, Paradise, in New Jersey. However, Primo's authentic food is too unfamiliar for the local tastes, and the restaurant is struggling. When famous Italian-American bandleader Louis Prima is scheduled to appear at Paradise, the two brothers put all of their efforts into the important meal, which will likely decide the fate of their restaurant.

Johnny Storm becomes the Human Torch, able to control and project fire, while his sister Sue becomes the Invisible Woman. Together, the team must harness their new abilities to prevent Doctor Doom from destroying the Earth.

Young Han Solo finds adventure when he joins forces with a gang of galactic smugglers and a 190-year-old Wookiee named Chewbacca. Indebted to the gangster Dryden Vos, the crew devises a daring plan to travel to the mining planet Kessel to steal a batch of valuable coaxium. In need of a fast ship, Solo meets Lando Calrissian, the suave owner of the perfect vessel for the dangerous mission -- the Millennium Falcon.

When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman (Billy Bob Thornton) determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry S. Stamper (Bruce Willis), who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J. (Ben Affleck), who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter (Liv Tyler), until the mission proves otherwise.
