p.t: Extreme Makeover: Home Edition Latin America
p.d: Un programa basado en el original Extreme Makeover de EE. UU., en donde un equipo de diseñadores reconstruyen y embellecen la casa de gente necesitada en un tiempo muy corto.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.

To find out if his reality is a physical or mental construct, Mr. Anderson, aka Neo, will have to choose to follow the white rabbit once more. If he's learned anything, it's that choice, while an illusion, is still the only way out of -- or into -- the Matrix. Neo already knows what he has to do, but what he doesn't yet know is that the Matrix is stronger, more secure and far more dangerous than ever before.
Billie must overcome the painful childhood memory of her sister's kidnapping before she can face the Dogan (Eric Steinberg) and prove her worth.
Paige's plan to get her job back as a social worker changes when her Whitelighter father, Sam (Scott Jaeck), asks for her help with his charge.
Agent Murphy gives the Charmed Ones their first Homeland Security case; Phoebe and Billie discover a belt that gives Billie superpowers.
The Charmed Ones help agent Murphy track a demon who escaped from the government's custody and learn that a virus is causing magical beings to run amok.
When the Angel of Death returns seeking Leo, the Charmed Ones try to use a spell to hide Leo, but it misfires and everyone suddenly looks like Leo.
Billie unknowingly contacts a demon posing as a human (Sean McDermott); Piper tries to deal with Leo's absence; Paige is able to connect with Henry (Ivan Sergei).
Paige tries to help Henry (Ivan Sergei) get his parolee, Nick, a loan at a bank, but when it denies him the loan, Nick crashes his car into the bank and holds everyone hostage.
Phoebe realizes that she must move on with her life and signs a lease for a new apartment; Paige considers moving in with Henry; Piper tries to maintain control after losing Leo.
A college professor whose career ended in disgrace when he became the prime suspect in the murder of a female student asks Rush to reopen the case.
Stillman asks Rush and Valens to reopen the 1980 case of an 8-year-old boy found buried in a snowdrift.

Just-paroled army ranger Cameron Poe (Nicolas Cage) is headed back to his wife (Monica Potter), but must fly home aboard a prison transport flight dubbed "Jailbird" with some of the worst criminals living. Along with Diamond Dog (Ving Rhames) and Baby-O (Mykelti Williamson), genius serial killer Cyrus "The Virus" Grissom (John Malkovich) unleashes a violent escape plot in mid-flight. Secretly working with U.S. Marshal Vince Larkin (John Cusack), Poe tries to foil Grissom's plan.

Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

El cirujano Danny decide contratar a su ayudante Katherine, una madre soltera con hijos, para que finjan ser su familia. Su intención es demostrarle a Palmer que su amor por ella es tan grande que está a punto de divorciarse de su mujer.
Un estafador veterano apoya a una joven y atractiva mujer, pero las cosas se complican cuando ellos se involucran románticamente.

Nicky (Will Smith), a veteran con artist, takes a novice named Jess (Margot Robbie) under his wing. While Nicky teaches Jess the tricks of the trade, the pair become romantically involved; but, when Jess gets uncomfortably close, Nicky ends their relationship. Three years later, Nicky is in Buenos Aires working a very dangerous scheme when Jess -- now an accomplished femme fatale -- unexpectedly shows up. Her appearance throws Nicky for a loop at a time when he cannot afford to be off his game.

When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city.

A round-up of the day's news.

Steve Backshall investigates how humans around the world are increasingly coming into contact with dangerous and potentially lethal animals. Along the way he finds bear and moose wandering the suburban streets of North America and helps a South African family remove a venomous snake from their garden.

Steve has a look at the incredible methods animals employ to protect themselves against predators. He trains with a kung fu expert and reveals the martial arts experts of the natural world, including a big-hitting shrimp and a mesmerising praying mantis.
Three challenges stand between the remaining sewers and the final: leather jackets, men's shirts and a little black dress.
A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

Jacqui Joseph is on patrol at Altrincham Recycling Centre, hoping to uncover three lucrative items amongst the skip-bound rubbish. Uzo shifts gears to turn car seat leather into stylish bags. Will it be a smooth ride, or will he stall at the start line? Upcycler Hannah's challenge is to breathe new life into two tired pieces of well-worn furniture - but will the results produce profits?

After three weeks of intense competition, the heats are over and only the best nine cooks remain. Now, it's the first of the semi-finals and the celebrities will be tested on their teamwork with their toughest challenge so far. Split into three teams, the celebrities venture outside the MasterChef kitchen for the first time for a tough challenge.

Michael Carrick made a dream start as ⚽ [EPL] Manchester United head coach with a 2-0 win over ⚽ [EPL] Manchester City in his first game in charge back in January. Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is unbeatable.

Michael Portillo experiences a terrifying 'victory roll' in a World War II Spitfire, high above the most famous aerodrome of the Battle of Britain, Biggin Hill. The 80-year-old aircraft, in which so many young men risked their lives for the nation, is one of a fleet intensively maintained by a dedicated team of technicians, and Michael is privileged to be flown by an ex-Royal Navy pilot.

Eva Longoria visits the state of Jalisco, where much of what is seen is quintessentially 'Mexican' originated. She also discovers that the state capital, Guadalajara, boasts some of the country's most cutting-edge restaurants.

The fairytale hills of Guilin and the cormorant fishermen of the Li River form the heart of this exploration of the colourful rice-growing cultures and strange creatures of southern China - a land of endless hills, mysterious caverns, spectacular rock pinnacles and traditional cultures with a taste for wildlife.

The Ulster Folk and Transport Museum in Northern Ireland hosts experts Thomas Plant and Caroline Hawley. Something out of the bags and boxes harks back to the era of traditional craftsmen. Paul Martin visits a family business that builds racing cars.

Larry Dean, Kirsty Gallagher, Sam Quek and Lemn Sissay take on a series of quiz rounds selected by Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week.

Clive travels 115 miles west of Havana to the stunning Viñales Valley, where he meets Cuban cowboys who are preparing for a unique race. He also discovers how farmers in this remote region are fighting back against ever stronger hurricanes.

p.t: Lost Relics of the Knights Templar
p.d: The black obsidian chalice, the most stunning relic in Hamilton and Carl's collection, is examined. The pair then head to Portugal to hunt for clues about the chalice's creation. Returning to the UK, the duo investigate its purpose.
David Dickinson presents from Aintree Racecourse in Liverpool as a church lamp turns out to be a bargain and Tim Hogarth is pressured by a seller's granddaughter.
A rare Rolling Stones record comes into the shop. Other times include a football used in the first Hall of Fame game and three swords from the Napoleonic era.
A banner from the WWII secret airborne division is brought into the shop, a customer brings in a 1980s Ooze-It toy, and Rick is muted by an unsigned illustration from the silent film era.
Don and the rest of the team travel to an industrial area of Toronto to attend an auction. Roy hopes to find some hidden treasures in these industrial units.
The father and son team of Bogart and Paul fight about Paul's propensity to spend. Meanwhile, Mike and Armando appear at an auction.
T-Money gives it both barrels as he bids on some mystery casks, before discovering a blinged-out German gun.
The bickering bargain hunters brave the weather and head to an auction in a wealthy Californian suburb. T-Money lands some fishing equipment.

Henry and Allen Millyard find and restore a legendary Triumph Trident bike, a triple cylinder masterpiece. Then, jumping on the back of the Flying Millyard, they head out for the historic Prescott Hill Climb to set up their stall and sell sell sell.
Henry Cole and his fellow Junketeers attempt to bring a vintage Morris 8 back to life, the team also get to grips with a Triumph chopper, with calamitous consequences.

The three junketeers head for Tewkesbury auction, and they buy so much stuff that they've really got their work cut out for them. Henry Cole then gets an unexpected phone call and their workshop gets a whole lot busier.

Henry Cole and his band of Junketeers visit a farm sale and come away with a vintage Massey Ferguson tractor — like a lot of good ideas at the time, they come to regret it and have to take drastic measures to get it sold.
It's time for Rick to party on when he checks out the queen of movie mobiles, the 'Wayne's World' car. Will he make an excellent deal, or will he decide it's not worthy?
Corey gets electrified when a 1952 Fender Telecaster guitar jams in. Will it have the rock 'n' roll chops, or will it get the axe?
Roy hires professional bodyguards to keep the riff-raff away at an auction in Brampton. Then, Bogart quits, but just when he thinks he's out of the business Paul tries to pull him back in.
Revolving around an adventurous mole's quest with friends to broker peace between humans and moles. Following the underground adventures of the charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley.

Mr Bean and Teddy go to the bowling alley, but Mr Bean finds bowling more difficult than expected.

Clarence pays bedridden Belson a visit at the hospital, but what Clarence thinks will cheer him up might actually drive Belson totally crazy! Clarence and Sumo look to throw together some quick cash so they can invest in a business venture.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
p.d: The boys are on the verge of discovering the truth about Elmore, but their old nemesis decides to rewrite the story. Nicole befriends a sympathetic AI, but as their bond grows, it tries to isolate her from the rest of the Wattersons.
A covert mission must be completed before cleaning the living room. / Mordecai gets freaked out by someone he used to babysit.
After releasing him for a reunion with his daughter, Marceline, Finn must defeat the Lord of Evil.
Starfire wins a goldfish at the carnival and vows to keep it alive for as long as possible. Beast Boy agrees to share his birthday with Starfire after learning she's never had a birthday on Earth.

While performing a school play, Gumball is so nervous about kissing Penny that he accidentally headbutts her and cracks open her shell. Gumball and Darwin are offended when Mum calls them "procrastinators", once she's told them what it means.
Mr Bean embarks on plenty of adventures, along with his sidekick, Teddy. They try to stay out of the way of Mrs Wicket and her cat Scrapper, but often end up in trouble.
What is a teen superhero's everyday life when the cape comes off? Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg deal with the usual issues of adolescence while trying to save the world.
Mr Bean's bath keeps getting interrupted, so he ends up having one in the garden! Mrs Wicket boots Mr Bean out for a night so her uncle can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean has a better plan.

After receiving a less-than-positive captain's review from an anonymous survey by the crew, Andar decides to go undercover on the Mighty Windbreaker to find out what the crew really think of him, forcing Lana to scramble.
When Saige is made school deputy and the power goes to her head, she and Gigi have their first fight.
Margaret wants to host a news segment; Rigby wants to give Mordecai a great birthday gift.

Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, but he never learns his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family.
Bytz plays Battle Royale while Wanda About hunts aliens. Mech-Max and Wanda About go from gorilla doctors and fire-fighting parrots to a prison escape with robot guards.
Join the CBBC crew for all your favourite programmes. Tune into CBBC every day from 7.00am.
Two alien kids land at the farm one night and run riot. Shaun and Bitzer must stop them before they wake the Farmer.

Danger Mouse and Jeopardy Mouse are on a mission in space. In the midst of an interstellar team-up, a bickering Danger Mouse and Jeopardy Mouse crash-land on a desolate planet. The stubborn pair split up in their new surroundings.
Twinkle feels she is being taken for granted by the other heroes, so she joins the Fairy Squad when they arrive.

p.t: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese
p.d: Noticing her recent boredom, Girl gives Cat her old favourite toy, Alfonso the Elf. Cat loves the toy until Girl starts insisting that Cat is playing with it the wrong way.
News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

The lemmings break Grizzly's sand statues. Furious, the bear sends them far away to build a huge statue in peace. But when he wants to take a photo next to his work, the lemmings attack with a pirate cannon.
The lemmings are hypnotised by a poster and suddenly think they are fitness trainers. They want to force Grizzy to work out, but he would rather continue to lie around than do push-ups and squats.
Plankton hides in a bottle posing as a wish-granting genie in his latest scheme to get the secret formula.
Duck has a job punting tourists along the waterways, but bored Frog thinks he can do a better job. Thanks to Frog's interference, the pair wind up going on a wild trip down the rapids.
Duck becomes a very serious librarian and makes it his mission to maintain the peace and quiet - that is until Frog arrives and has other ideas.
Opie leads her first public tour through HQ, but when Orwell discovers one member of the tour group is a villain, they must work out who it is before it is too late.

Steve Backshall meets the hammerhead shark, a shark with some seriously super senses. He heads to his shark lab to reveal how their bizarrely shaped head allows them to detect electrical fields given off by their prey.
Learn about movement lines, designing a skateboard and colour theory.
There is a terrible smell in the Houses of Parliament, Cinderella struggles with the Blitz, and Helen of Troy reveals her complicated love life.
Four strangers work as a team to answer general knowledge questions. They must defeat the Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius, in order to win money.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

All that stands between Autumn, Tree, Bear and Robin and thousands of pounds is one of the country's finest quiz brains.
Bradley Walsh is behind Thomas, Yvonne, Alun and Rosie all the way as they try to beat one of the country's finest quiz brains and take home thousands of pounds.
Bradley Walsh hosts as presenter Matt Allwright, singer Stacey Solomon, newsreader Louise Minchin, and actor Keith Allen put their knowledge to the test.

Nigel Havers welcomes five more sellers to the Bidding Room, where they try to sell items to professional dealers who are on the lookout for interesting pieces, with help from expert Simon Bower. First through the doors is Rebekah, who hopes her ornate pair of grand brass candelabras with delicate milk glass flowers will secure her a good deal. Connor wants to raise money to treat both his grandads to a Newcastle United football match.

Anne Reid and Thelma Barlow, two veteran actresses and stars of the BBC comedy `Dinnerladies', team up with antiques experts Paul Laidlaw and David Harper for a whistle-stop celebrity road trip around Oxfordshire. Armed with a classic car and £400 each, the two teams compete to buy antiques to sell for a profit at auction in Penkridge, Staffordshire. Later a trip to see war-time art work conjures up fond but emotional memories for Anne.

Lily Savage hosts the game show in which contestants try to match the answers of as many of the six celebrity panellists as possible, featuring Rob Butler, Natalie Casey, Sue Cleaver, Elizabeth Estensen, Mark Moraghan, and Simon Rouse.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.
Work colleagues and friends Colleen, Emma, Tracey and Steph take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.
Jude from Dublin, Nick from Hull, Su from Gloucestershire and Chante from Manchester take on the Chaser in the hope they'll go home with thousands of pounds.

Stars of stage and screen, Simon Williams and Duncan Preston team up with antiques experts James Lewis and Philip Serrell for a celebrity buying trip around Essex. Armed with £400 each and two stunning classic cars, their mission - to acquire items to sell for profit at auction in Torquay, Devon. On the way Duncan tries his hand at an ancient craft and a collector of sporting memorabilia has a tale to tell about London Mayor Boris Johnson.
Fearne Cotton and Chris Moyles face off against each other as they compete to win a big cash prize for their chosen charity, with a little help from their families.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.
Lisa makes a warts-and-all documentary about life with her family. Though the flick is a Sundance success, it turns the Simpsons into national hate figures.
When Homer learns he needs a heart bypass operation after having a heart attack at work, he searches for the cheapest doctor.
Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Katharine Merry in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.
Doug and Carrie miss the point of giving, when their modest charitable contribution to a local library is mistaken for a much larger one, and they are feted accordingly.
Doug tries to keep $5,000 in gambling winnings a secret from Carrie, who didn't want him betting to begin with. Plus, Carrie is offered a new job.
While undergoing a root canal, Doug discovers that Carrie knew the dentist while growing up and had a big crush on him.
Ray worries that he has passed on stupid genes to Michael because his son may be held back a year at school, just like Ray was.
Ray thinks a family portrait would make a great Christmas present for his parents, until Marie and Debra clash over who counts as family.
Ray and Debra have wildly differing opinions of how to react to the news that Ally has been bullying another child on the school bus.

Frasier's attempts to become condominium president take a new turn when he persuades Martin to run as a 'puppet' candidate who, naturally enough, will receive his full backing. However, Martin quickly rumbles his scheming son's game, and decides to run his own campaign.

Roz's 20-year-old cousin is quite the party girl, to the extent that when she arrives in Seattle, Frasier finds it impossible to keep up with her. Meanwhile, Martin is running into a spot of bother with the flat now that Daphne has left.
Frasier vows revenge after Bulldog plays a prank on him, and Daphne's mum wages war against a scorned trick-or-treater in a practical joke grudge match.
Frasier fails to deliver Scott Bakula's autograph to the avid "Star Trek" fan who is teaching him Hebrew for Frederick's Bar Mitzvah, and Daphne discovers Niles shared a night of passion with Lilith.
While out to explore two promising, packed picks, Mike tries to get Frank into the right Christmas spirit.

While undergoing a root canal, Doug discovers that Carrie knew the dentist while growing up and had a big crush on him.
Ray worries that he has passed on stupid genes to Michael because his son may be held back a year at school, just like Ray was.
Ray thinks a family portrait would make a great Christmas present for his parents, until Marie and Debra clash over who counts as family.
Ray and Debra have wildly differing opinions of how to react to the news that Ally has been bullying another child on the school bus.

Frasier's attempts to become condominium president take a new turn when he persuades Martin to run as a 'puppet' candidate who, naturally enough, will receive his full backing. However, Martin quickly rumbles his scheming son's game, and decides to run his own campaign.

Roz's 20-year-old cousin is quite the party girl, to the extent that when she arrives in Seattle, Frasier finds it impossible to keep up with her. Meanwhile, Martin is running into a spot of bother with the flat now that Daphne has left.
Frasier vows revenge after Bulldog plays a prank on him, and Daphne's mum wages war against a scorned trick-or-treater in a practical joke grudge match.
Frasier fails to deliver Scott Bakula's autograph to the avid "Star Trek" fan who is teaching him Hebrew for Frederick's Bar Mitzvah, and Daphne discovers Niles shared a night of passion with Lilith.
While out to explore two promising, packed picks, Mike tries to get Frank into the right Christmas spirit.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

p.t: The Wonderful World of Chocolate: Signed
p.d: Meet the biggest Willy Wonka collector in the world, watch Brighton Pavilion carved out of chocolate and explore the history of the Cadbury's Crème Egg.
A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.
The Ruff-Ruff Pack takes over Humdinger's lair and runs off with his kitties.
The Mixmups go on an adventure to have the best Halloween party ever, however, one little Wingle isn't joining in. So, the Mixmups work together to find a way to make the party fun for everyone.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.
A shadow on the tent spooks Fluff and threatens to spoil Tweedy's camping plan!

Odo follows his beetle pal Scuttle into Camp Leader's hut and accidentally gets locked inside with Rosie and Flo. While they wait to be rescued, Odo keeps their spirits up using a ping pong ball and a tin of peaches.

When the Fat Controller asks Sidney to go to Brendam Docks to collect Percy's new wheels, Sidney worries that he might forget as his memory isn't very good. Thomas suggests making up a little song to help him remember, but will Sidney remember when he gets distracted?
When Dilys overloads a socket at the Cut Price Store and starts a fire, Mandy learns that every job on the Fire Rescue team is the most important job!
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Playing 'Capture the Piggy', Pip and Zac can't agree on a plan to evade 'evil queen' Posy and capture Piggy. So they have to learn how to work together.
Noises are coming from the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure.
A mighty wind sweeps Zuma and Harrigan off the beach and blows them all the way up to Jake's Mountain.
A herd of bison are migrating through Builder Cove-right toward City Hall! Rubble & Crew hop in their big vehicles to save the day.

Cleveland Junior und Roberta machen einen Schulausflug nach Washington. Ihre Eltern freuen sich schon darauf, dass sie dann ein wenig Zeit zu zweit verbringen können. Doch Rallo will sich als Mann im Haus behaupten, was die Ruhe gehörig stört.
Henriettes Eltern kommen nur schwer damit klar, dass ihre Tochter mit Goth-Kids herumhängt. Nach einer Beratung wird entschieden, die Tochter in ein Camp zu schicken.

Zwischen Ike und Kyle gibt es immer mehr Probleme. Seit Ike in die Pubertät gekommen ist, streiten sie sich unentwegt. In der Hoffnung, dass das ihrer angeknacksten Beziehung guttut, nimmt Kyle Ike zur Live-Performance von "Yo Gabba Gabba" mit.

Cartman hat angeblich eine rothaarige Kuh mit Sommersprossen entdeckt und trägt so fast zum Weltfrieden wegen einer Weissagung der großen Religionen bei, doch Kyle durchschaut Cartmans schlechten Scherz und versucht, ihn zur Vernunft zu bringen.
Tina und Darryl wollen den "Cupid's Couple"-Wettbewerb auf dem Schulball gewinnen und arbeiten als Team. Valentinstag steht bald an und Linda hat einige Pläne für sich und Bob gemacht.

Tina und Louise wollen Jimmy dabei helfen, Klassensprecher zu werden. Das tun sie allerdings nur, um ein noch größeres Übel zu vermeiden - Millie als Klassensprecherin. Bob hat sich in ein Messer verguckt, das 300 Dollar kostet.

Stan löscht versehentlich Francines Gedächtnis, sodass sie denkt, dass sie im Jahr 1985 leben würde. Er muss alle Hebel in Bewegung setzen, um sie zurück in die Gegenwart zu holen, auch die Entführung von Whitney Houston stellt da ein angebrachtes Mittel dar. Steve überwindet unterdessen seine Angst und fragt Lindsay Coolidge, ob sie mit ihm gehen will.

Um einen Rivalen bei der Arbeit loszuwerden, lädt Stan seinen Boss zu einem vergnüglichen Abendessen nach Hause ein. Stan diskreditiert den Kollegen als Terroristen, weil dieser beim Pita-Sandwich-Essen fotografiert wurde.

Die Abbott Elementary macht einen Ausflug zum Franklin Institute. Obwohl Gregory mehr Zeit mit Janine verbringen will, meidet sie ihn. Ava bringt den Kindern etwas über außerirdisches Leben bei. Danach bricht ein Chaos aus.

Chris fühlt sich ohne Greg sehr einsam. Zum Trost besucht er den Hauswirtschaftsunterricht, da es dort vor hübschen Mädchen nur so wimmelt. Weil Chris gut backen kann, macht er sich in seiner Klasse schnell beliebt und hofft, dadurch seinen Klassenkameradinnen näherzukommen. Als ihm jedoch als Partner Angel zugeteilt wird, erlebt Chris eine böse Überraschung.

Der geliebte Truck von Mike steht nach zehn Jahren vor seiner vollständigen Restaurierung. Die Familie des Vorbesitzers hat ihm sogar den Kaufvertrag gegeben, doch wird der Truck mitten in der Nacht gestohlen und Mike ist untröstlich.

Weil seine Frau befördert wurde, soll sich Macho Mike in Zukunft zu Hause um seine Töchter und seinen kleinen Enkel kümmern. Damit bricht nicht nur für Mike selbst die Welt zusammen, auch seinen Töchtern graut vor dieser Vorstellung.

Malcolm und seine Freunde machen bei einem akademischen Achtkampf mit. Ihr Lehrer will den Wettkampf unbedingt gewinnen und schreckt auch vor Betrug nicht zurück. Malcolm ist damit nicht einverstanden.

Lois und Hal unternehmen einen neuen Versuch, ihr Testament zu schreiben, doch schon schnell streiten sie sich. Sie werfen sich gegenseitig vor, kläglich versagt zu haben in Sachen Erziehung und Geld.

Alberta bietet Sam an, ihr beim Vorsprechen für eine Rolle bei einer örtlichen Theatergruppe zu helfen. Dabei verliebt sich Sasappis Hals über Kopf in eine der Schauspielerinnen und nutzt Jays Träume, um ihr näherzukommen.

p.d: Jimmy Carr, GK Barry, and Jamali Maddix put petty behaviours under the microscope, including a woman who lied about her age to a partner, a mum who takes extreme measures over her daughter's mess, and someone with questionable hotel buffet etiquette.
Comedian Babatunde Aleshe delivers a new batch of the funniest clips out there. Includes fails like work-outs gone wrong, flukiest trick-shots, and adults versus kids.

p.t: Whose Line Is It Anyway? USA
p.d: Aisha Tyler hosts this skit comedy show where the actors on the show, usually Wayne Brady, Colin Mochrie, Ryan Stiles and another guest star or two do different comedy skits. It's all improv and made up on the spot.
Stuart lobbies to become Carter's new roommate; James tries to protect a rat that is on the loose in Mike's office.
Mike promises to coordinate Paul and Claudia's wedding, but he discovers the church is booked for a funeral.

Monica and Ross mourn the death of their grandmother with a little help from the gang, and Monica and her mum come to an unspoken understanding about the relationship between mothers and daughters. Meanwhile, Chandler is irritated by office speculation that he is gay.

Monica's first Thanksgiving dinner for the gang goes horribly wrong when they all get locked on the roof after watching a giant runaway balloon from the New York Thanksgiving parade. Elsewhere, Joey wins his first modelling gig as the poster boy for a venereal disease campaign, and Ross competes with his ex-wife to communicate with their unborn baby.

As New Year approaches, the gang make a pact to celebrate at Monica and Rachel's flat without bringing any dates. However, as the New Year gets closer, all of them find themselves breaking that promise except for Ross, who brings along his new pet monkey Marcel.
Chandler's flamboyant mother visits New York, while Phoebe and Monica flirt with a handsome stranger while crossing a road and end up causing a traffic accident.

When mother-to-be Rhoni Reuter is shot in her Chicago home, attention is directed at the baby's father, Shaun Gayle. But it's discovered that Shaun has more girlfriends than just Rhoni, and more than one of them has an issue with that.

When Sue Snow takes some pills and dies from cyanide poisoning, police think they have another random 'Chicago Tylenol Poisoning' on their hands. But when a second victim appears, it starts to look like someone has a personal motive.
A deadly home invasion sparks a manhunt for a stranger terrorising a housing complex in Tulsa, Okla.

When teenagers find a woman's corpse after attending a party, detectives have some gut-wrenching news to break when a woman is found strangled with her shoelace. First, they face the tough task of identifying her.
Two best friends are gunned down on a dark residential street. When a string of disappointments threatens to derail the case, Lt Joe Kenda enlists the help of an old acquaintance.
Officer Brittany Johnson joins the Lake Ozark PD's ranks and gets a baptism by fire responding to a series of chaotic fights and bloody medical emergencies on The Strip.

An aspiring rapper is arrested after performing on top of a billboard; a man is caught licking the doorbell intercom of a home; a detained shoplifting suspect escapes her handcuffs and steals a police car.
A grieving uncle screams at his sister-in-law in court over his missing nephew, an autoworker checks in to his virtual hearing from the assembly line, a road rage killer blames his victim, and more.

p.t: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
p.d: Will Mellor and a panel of experts uncover the shocking case of ex-traffic officer Keith Farquharson, found guilty of murdering his wife Alice in 2019.

p.t: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
p.d: Will Mellor and a panel of experts uncover the case of former LA detective Stephanie Lazarus, who was convicted of murdering her ex-boyfriend's wife in 1986.

p.t: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
p.d: Will Mellor and a panel of experts examine the tragic case of Sarah Everard, who was kidnapped and killed by off-duty police officer Wayne Couzens in 2021.
A deadly fall in the shower claims the life of a beloved community leader, but when a friend and former medical examiner voices her suspicions, the case takes a shocking turn.

A California Granny is thought of as a 'Mother Teresa' to the downtrodden thanks to the boarding house she runs. But when a social worker raises fears for a missing client, investigators find that Granny's carefully tended garden hides horrors.

An ailing man isn't seen for weeks, and his family and friends grow concerned. When his wife is confronted about her changing stories, her revelation shocks the community, and everyone who knows and loves her as a dedicated grandmother.

A veteran cop falls for a beloved grandma he hopes to spend the rest of his life with, but when a home cooked meal sends them both racing to the hospital… this granny's gravy, and her sordid past, are brought under scrutiny.

Officers find $6.5 million of cocaine in a secret compartment in a bus fuel tank, and a man is spotted putting something into his shoes. But what is he hiding?
Officers find 70 packets of methamphetamine hidden in the floor of a woman's car, and a young boxer is detained over an outstanding warrant for evading arrest.

Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest, and hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast, abundant with mussels and oysters. At home, he cooks a memorable dish of steak frites with bordelaise sauce.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy tackle a monstrous wall of death in some very cheap insurance write-offs. The trio also take a Yorkshire road trip in classic supercars, and Freddie attempts to hit 200mph in an old Jaguar.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy head to Cyprus on a budget rental car adventure, and sample the exciting new sport of car water-skiing. Back at the test track, Chris and Paddy sample the latest family cars from Audi and Lamborghini.

Paul and Bob return to the Peak District. They start by fishing the Wye at Haddon Hall, hoping to catch chub, rainbow trout and wild brown trout, before moving on to the Derwent. As they cast, they recall memories of their first trip.
Motorcycle racer and engineering enthusiast Guy Martin's project is to help overhaul steam locomotive 5164, a tank engine which is currently used on the popular Severn Valley Railway.

Dave Myers and Si King cook dishes from their favourite cookbooks and also meet food historian Ivan Day, who has one of the world's most extensive historical cookbook collections in the UK. The Bikers also tell the story of some of Britain's most iconic food writers, such as Elizabeth David and Isabella Beeton.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Der Seegang bringt die Männer in ernstzunehmende Gefahr. Trotzdem denken sie nicht ans Aufgeben. Schließlich müssen die Krabbenfischer Geld verdienen. Deswegen versuchen alle, die Zähne zusammenzubeißen und durchzuhalten.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Alles oder nichts: Schiffskapitän Scott Campbell Jr. und seine Besatzung gehen in dieser Episode in der Beringsee hohe Risiken ein. Denn die Crew ist durch eine unfreiwillige Auszeit beim Krabbenfang ins Hintertreffen geraten. Damit die Fangsaison für die Seeleute nicht zum finanziellen Fiasko wird, nehmen sie Kurs auf das berüchtigte Kontinentalschelf. Die Region ist bekannt für ihre riesigen Eismeerkrabbenpopulationen. Die Tiere dort ausfindig zu machen gleicht jedoch einem Vabanquespiel.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Am Hafen von Ambarlı wird ein Sattelauflieger entladen. Es besteht der Verdacht, dass darin verbotene Waren geschmuggelt werden. Die Beamten ordnen die Fracht im Kontrollbereich so an, dass ein Spürhund die Pakete beschnüffeln kann.

Auf der Öresundbrücke verstricken sich zwei Norweger in Widersprüche. Die Männer haben Alkohol für eine Hochzeitsfeier eingekauft. Eine Taschenlampe mit eingebauter Elektroschock-Funktion wird als illegales Souvenir aus Südostasien konfisziert.

A look back at a selection of the wide variety of sports covered by ITV during the 1980s - from football to wrestling, double-decker bus racing to boxing - and including many iconic and memorable moments.

In aptly named Pickens, South Carolina, the guys scour the sprawling inventory of a father-and-son picking duo. They uncover plenty of rare and unusual items, but can they make a deal with the two pro collectors? Next, the guys meet Mary who has inherited a 300-acre property, home to a huge untouched collection. After warming up with a few impulse purchases, Mike and Frank get serious.

Arthur is tricked by a young Australian girl into helping find her boyfriend who has gone missing, with her share of some fraudulent loot.

Doyle loses a friend to a brutal beating and faces suspension as CI5 smash an international drug-smuggling ring.
Nemesis sends its superagents to investigate why a country is breaking an international treaty by testing nuclear weapons under Antarctica.

While in Kansas, the guys comb through a promising farmyard littered with stuff but are frustrated when they find nothing at all to buy. Their luck changes when they meet demolition expert Johnny Walker. His collection is staggering. However, will he agree to part with a rare grave marker and giant 300-pound boot? The next day, Johnny refers the guys to his collector neighbours.

Mike and Frank are in Missouri, heading towards an inherited old farm with plenty of promise, but then Danielle calls with news about an ultimate prize. She's tracked down a prolific collector with a rare 1937 Harley Knucklehead. Close to their target, and revved up about the classic bike, the guys agree to speed pick the old farm before moving on.
Regan is determined to nail a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde who have already made fools of the police after one of them escaped from an ambulance following an audacious wages' theft.
Cowley winds up being accused of treachery when he tries to flush out a Soviet double agent working in MI5.
Arthur is asked to speak to the local Rotary Club, while Terry acts as a hotel house detective.

Veterans and rookie drivers alike will have to battle thick Amazon jungles, landslides and cliffside routes where any mistake can be fatal.

Jill hopes to charm her guests with her authentic 17th-century B&B, the Castle Arms Inn, in North Yorkshire. However, a rough night's sleep for two of her guests might scupper her chances.
The B&Bers are off to enjoy the great outdoors at Liz and Dave Johnson's Eden Valley glamping site in Cumbria, where the hosts show off their back-to-basics way of doing things.
At Fernie Castle in Fife, run by Neil and Mary Blackburn, there's plenty of traditional Scots splendour on show. However, two of the guests aren't impressed by the continental breakfast.
The last visit of the week is to the Cadillac Kustomz Hotel on the Isle of Bute, where owners Brody and Rima hope to rock their guests' worlds with a music-filled, retro retreat.
On payment day, there are certain complaints and breakfast blues as the B&Bers iron out their issues, before they find out how much they've been paid and who's won the week.
First to host in Birmingham is hair and beauty tutor April Richards. April plans a starter of zebra meat. Might a puppy in a pot and a raw dessert save the day?
The second to host in Birmingham is scientist John Fennel, who wants to bring his lab skills to his dinner party.
Banker Vanessa Erigbogbo describes herself as a 'brilliant cook'. Her menu includes lobster, confit of duck, and fried grasshopper canapés.

Strict vegetarian Paz Thakrar starts his preparations by milking a cucumber to get rid of any evil cucumber toxins. However, his avid meat-eating guests aren't all happy about his veggie menu and his karaoke plans.
Last up in Birmingham is insolvency administrator Toni Shukla. Given her competitors' efforts so far, Toni could quite comfortably take the prize.
First hosts are David Lewis and Giles Beaton at Langland Road in the Mumbles, who take a hi-tech approach to running their B&B.
Margaret Dugdall runs Castle Lodge Hotel in Felixstowe to exacting standards, but when her daughter Ruth leaves clues in the bedrooms, not all the guests are pleased.
Gordon and Sandra McCallum run Bryn Woodlands House in Colwyn Bay and take their guests harness racing. But how will one guest react to finding a snake in his bed?
The final B&B of the week is the Tollemache Arms in Cheshire, where 24-year-old all-round performer Edward Prophet and his fiancée Rachel Pickup like to add some showbiz razzmatazz.

In the mountains, the chamois, lynx and brown bears roam the Velebit range against the backdrop of the breathtaking Adriatic Sea.
Wildlife SOS rescue a begging elephant from the streets, a paralysed monkey, and a deadly venomous cobra in a school classroom.
Ahead of the Percy DeWolfe Memorial Mail Race, Dr Oakley looks in on sled dogs old and new, and a feral cat needs a check-up.
In Quebec, Michelle helps scientists fighting to save a caribou herd and relocate pregnant females by helicopter.
Witness once-in-a-lifetime scenes, from a buffalo chase to a lion cub's race against time. Emotions run high as safari drama is up close and personal.
Australia's vast eucalyptus forests are home to remarkably rich fauna found nowhere else on Earth. These ancient ecosystems have remained largely unchanged since the age of the dinosaurs.

Skilled craftspeople are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life. With demanding customers and high turnover, their hard work turns rubbish to treasure.
Drew finds rare pieces that have stood the test of time. They include an 18th century cabinet in superb original condition and a chest from the Vatican.
Exploring Ireland's thriving antiques world, Drew and new buying partner Alister uncover treasures in private homes and showrooms across the country.
Jacqui and Andrew face a night-time detecting mission for lost gold.

The Gold Devils decide to take a huge gamble when Alan and Salty go off-road and into the wilderness of Kimberley. Shane and Kate do their best to get two wet plants going, however, they run out of water.
In the race to meet a rainbow matrix order ahead of the Lightning Ridge Opal Festival, The Misfits bet everything on untested DIY contraptions.
Drowning in a sea of overburden, The Blacklighters face off against each other as Mark's inexperience with the dozer proves too much for Paul.

Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. Wood expert Will Kirk is entrusted with a dearly loved wooden soldier's trunk that has been passed down five generations of one family. Now custodian Luke is embarking on officer training at Sandhurst and would like to take his great-great-grandfather Sidney's military chest with him.

Henry and Fuzz uncover a rare 1972 Yamaha TX500 in Steve's eclectic shed. But with mechanical gremlins lurking beneath the surface, can the team overcome the challenges and make this forgotten seventies machine roar once again?
Henry and Fuzz visit Martin in Worcestershire and find a Lister D Stationary Engine. Can they restore this classic on its 100th year anniversary or have they bitten off more than they can chew?
In a dusty warehouse, Henry and Fuzz uncover a rare Armstrong Siddeley Hurricane convertible. Can they revive this British classic?

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: The boys are in Hay on Wye and Bedford, where Henry lovingly restores a bespoke workbench and Simon ponders the possibilities of some discarded planks of wood.
Angus visits an ex-soldier with a collection of vintage Action Man figures. A football fanatic wins big when he sells his ⚽ [EPL] Crystal Palace memorabilia.

p.d: Julie wants two groups with two different dresses; Tayla is having problems with her bridal party; Lori's team is having a tough time pulling dresses.

p.t: Say Yes to the Dress: Bridesmaids
p.d: The rule of no men in the salon has been ignored. The men start causing trouble for the brides and bridesmaids.

p.t: Say Yes to the Dress: Bridesmaids
p.d: Bride Meghan is furious with her limelight-hogging Maid of Honour, while bride LaToya's choice of dress has her Maid of Honour spilling out.

p.t: Say Yes to the Dress: Bridesmaids
p.d: Bride Dianna wants her sister to wear a dress for the first time in 15 years and Bride Amber wants a dress in "Azalea Leaf Green" but her sister is not on board.
Michaella is getting married in an Irish castle and wants a princess dress for her big day. Plus, fashionista Shavonne has a high-style reputation to maintain.

A family whose lives were destroyed forever, after a mother of two left her children in the care of her ex-husband. A case of fraudulent activity at the hands of a carer, who took advantage of those she was supposed to look after.
When Katherine Smith connects with Tony Moore on a dating site, she believes she's finally found love. But her dreams shatter when his true identity is revealed.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: After police find a young mother bound and murdered in her bedroom, her family challenges police to bring a heartless killer to justice.
When the body of Fernando Silva is found, the crime scene reveals little about what caused his death.
A cunning fraudster makes a habit out of exploiting women for money after successfully murdering his first wife for a life insurance payout.

Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

The Bay of Fundy, on Canada's east coast, is home to the world's highest tides. The Bay's surging waters and the mudflats below them sustain an abundance of creatures, and a complex web of invertebrates.
Vets are called to the park due to serious concerns for the health of elderly chimp Zoe.

Female orangutans, RoRo and Lucy, are reintroduced in the hope they can learn to live together; marmoset Gizmo gets the all-clear; Alison plans a house swap to ease the conflict between Bart's group and the bachelor chimps.

Their ancestors were the first vertebrates to colonise dry land and frogs inhabit every continent except Antarctica, but their world is rapidly changing. What was once wetlands is now playgrounds, golf courses and racetracks.
Deer season means the rehab is flooded with fawns. Chelsea tries to reunite one fawn with its mother, while two police officers rescue another.

Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clan's symbiotic link to fruiting ana trees, a meerkat's alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.
Hoolock gibbons live the high life in the rainforests of northeast India, leaping through the trees in search of the perfect meal.

p.t: The PA and the Manhattan Prince
p.d: Loyal, quick-thinking Lucy Woods is a personal assistant to the stars, but when Prince Rupert arrives in New York to make preparations for a masked ball, Lucy finds herself falling in love with her new employer.
Sparks fly between a struggling writer and a British tourist as they spend Christmas week in New York City's Grand Fairbanks Hotel.
When Emily wishes for a perfect Christmas like the ones found in the popular Sugarplum movies, she's shocked when Sugarplum herself appears to help her fulfil it.
A fake marriage proposal goes viral, and all the attention helps two strangers with their struggling businesses. Millie and Leo play pretend while trying to ignore their growing feelings.
A librarian is magically transported into the story of "Pride and Prejudice" and meets Mr. Darcy.

When a real estate exec returns home after her archaeologist-dad passes, she's told the only way she'll inherit his estate is if she finds the treasure that ever eluded him. She teams up with a cranky farmer who owns the land where X marks the spot.
When Lolly's Aunt Gert gives her four magical lemon drops, she gets to experience what her life would have been like if she had made different choices and lived those unfulfilled dreams.

p.t: Fuerza latina, mujeres inspiradoras de América Latina
p.d: Las mujeres latinoamericanas ganan protagonismo en todos los ámbitos. Con tenacidad y perseverancia, se proponen mejorar el mundo que les rodea y alzan su voz para reclamar derechos, denunciar injusticias y un mayor protagonismo en la sociedad.
Espacio de información, asesoría y apoyo al televidente en diversos ámbitos, educativos, sociales, familiares y de salud entre otros.
Un ciclo que tiene como propósito vincular a México y España, al abordar temas de interés común.
La obra maestra de Chaplin comentada por uno de los pilares del cine de crítica social.
Un químico demente utiliza murciélagos mutados para vengarse de los ejecutivos que se aprovecharon de sus inventos.

El lugar para revivir los sucesos y las noticias más importantes del fin de semana, combinados con entrevistas, emotivas historias y reseñas de todo el mundo deportivo. Secciones dedicadas a fútbol, NFL, MLB, NBA y más.

Una calurosa bienvenida al hombre por el que las damas pierden la razón y los hombres pierden a sus novias, el Vítor. Se enfrentan dos equipos, Lunáticos vs. Tochitos para demostrar quién es el equipo más trucha.
Un programa dominical sobre las decisiones en Washington, D. C. y sus consecuencias en la vida cotidiana de los latinos que trabajan, votan y construyen sus vidas en Estados Unidos.
Una mujer le prohíbe a su hija tener contacto con el mundo debido a su enfermedad, pero los cuidados extremos que le da no serán suficientes para que su bella adolescente conozca al amor de su vida.
Vicky recibe a un invitado que lleva a Latinoamérica en su alma: Luis Enrique.

Los habitantes de Nacotitlán amanecen con la noticia de que una constructora hará una carretera que pasará por su colonia, pero la arquitecta Pilar Maldonado les promete una casa nueva y una jugosa indemnización.

p.t: Noticiero N+ Univision: Fin de semana
p.d: La información más importante y actualizada de lo que ha sucedido en el mundo durante el fin de semana, realizado por un equipo de periodistas apasionados por su trabajo, objetivos y veraces que dan las últimas noticias y el resumen de la semana.
Camilo amenaza a Venus con marcarle la cara para que cada vez que se vea al espejo lo recuerde.
Revista matutina con noticias, temas de actualidad, reportajes de farándula, música e información práctica.
Hugo comparte videos presumiendo que tiene mucho dinero, pero en realidad no es así, lo que lo lleva a encontrarse con unos farsantes que lo quieren extorsionar.
Noticiero que transmite los hechos mundiales relevantes para la comunidad hispana. Presentado por jóvenes periodistas en un ambiente informal.
Los Rivers solo tienen dinero para comer atún. Así que Frankie envía a Benito a hacer el casting para interpretar al Sol. Pero Luis propone realizar un nuevo reglamento de convivencia vecinal.

Las presentadoras también exponen sus vivencias personales, sus experiencias profesionales, sus opiniones y sus sentimientos.

p.t: La Dr. Polo vida sin límites
p.d: Ana María Polo revela su secreto para vivir sin límites. Acompáñala junto al Dr. Ramos mientras exploran la ciencia detrás del alivio natural. Además, comparten historias inspiradoras de personas reales que recuperan sus vidas.

Dante y Erick llevan 20 años juntos, pero ahora Dante tiene la oportunidad de regresar a España para trabajar. Sin embargo, Erick piensa que su relación no funcionará si están lejos.

Germán intenta ser uno de los mejores porteros, pero en su intento se llevará varios vidrios rotos. Pedrito estrena lentes.
Los López Pérez son nominados por el comité de Angangueo para ganar un premio. Roxana cuida a la mascota de una celebridad por una noche.
El padre de Rumieta le prohíbe ver a Julio después de una pelea con su familia, los Montesco. Pero Julio, enamorado, llama al Chapulín para que lo ayude.
El Chapulín y Julio intentan que el padre de Rumieta les permita casarse. Rumieta finge su muerte y se sorprende al ver lo que le ha ocurrido a su amado Julio.

Don Ramón invita al Chavo a ver fútbol en su casa, pero la Chilindrina lo echa, así que se va a casa de Quico. En el mejor momento del partido, la Chilindrina los interrumpe, y Quico se pierde el gol.
El profesor Jirafales le pide ayuda a don Ramón para declararle a doña Florinda lo que siente por ella. Sin embargo, los niños pueden imaginar muchas cosas ante la escena.

El Chapulín ayuda a una joven a librarse del matrimonio con un joven al que no ama. El Chapulín usa su chicharra paralizadora con todos y les hace maldades.

Germán intenta ser uno de los mejores porteros, pero en su intento se llevará varios vidrios rotos. Pedrito estrena lentes.
Los López Pérez son nominados por el comité de Angangueo para ganar un premio. Roxana cuida a la mascota de una celebridad por una noche.
El padre de Rumieta le prohíbe ver a Julio después de una pelea con su familia, los Montesco. Pero Julio, enamorado, llama al Chapulín para que lo ayude.
El Chapulín y Julio intentan que el padre de Rumieta les permita casarse. Rumieta finge su muerte y se sorprende al ver lo que le ha ocurrido a su amado Julio.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: El equipo está en problemas después de que el capitán Cragen despierta al lado de una acompañante muerta - una testigo potencial - en su cama. Las tensiones aumentan en la oficina cuando los detectives contienden con la investigación de Cragen, así como la llegada del nuevo capitán.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Un famoso conductor de televisión ataca a la joven escritora de una novela erótica. El detective Amaro descubre un secreto que podría dañar la carrera de la autora y su caso.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: La brigada de víctimas especiales intenta acabar con una operación de tráfico sexual que esclaviza a mujeres jóvenes; cuando la investigación es detenida por la Tte. Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe), el detective Benson tiene que ser creativo.
Severide investiga un incendio sospechoso en una escuela. Novak recibe una llamada inesperada. Violet trae a un bombero 51 a bordo de la ambulancia para un turno.
Las sospechas de Voight resultan ser verdad cuando un violento allanamiento lleva a la Unidad de Inteligencia a reencontrarse con una figura temible de un caso anterior.
Charles sospecha cada vez más de las intenciones de un colega. Lenox hace algo indebido para proteger a un paciente. Asher y Archer tratan a un futuro padre que sufre de cáncer.
Un periodista recibe un disparo mientras entrevista a un primer ministro y todos los indicios apuntan a un intento de asesinato.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Una joven trabajadora sexual desaparece. Rollins y Velasco encuentran una pista clave en una pila de informes de personas desaparecidas.

p.d: Carisi le pide ayuda a la UVE con la investigación de un asesinato cuando uno de los testigos muestra signos de abuso.

p.d: Carisi juzga a Richard Wheatley por el asesinato de Kathy Stabler. Benson se encuentra en desacuerdo con un amigo cuando Barba acepta tomar el caso.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: El secuestro de un niño les recuerda a Cragen, Munch y Benson un caso sin resolver ocurrido 13 años antes.

Will se enfrenta a una decisión moral cuando su exprofesor enfrenta una enfermedad que amenaza su vida. Rodas no está de acuerdo con el padre de un joven paciente acerca de un procedimiento arriesgado. Sarah recuerda el suicidio de Jason Wheeler.

Los médicos deben diagnosticar a pacientes sin tecnología porque un hacker ha apagado el sistema informático del hospital. Goodwin recibe una visita de su exesposo, Bert, y su nueva novia. Choi y Noah extraen una bala de una víctima de tiroteo.
McLeod empuja a Boden hacia un retiro anticipado y elige a su potencial sustituto. Todos expresan su odio por el espía. Shay disfruta de una vida social plena.

Severide se encuentra con un chico que necesita ayuda mientras hacía ejercicio. Boden y McLeod se enfrentan por el futuro de la estación de bomberos. Mouch y Greg Sullivan debaten sobre el pódcast de Otis.

Tras treinta años de tranquilidad, los fantasmas y demonios han vuelto a Nueva York para aterrorizar a los ciudadanos. Esta vez, una investigadora de lo paranormal, una física, una ingeniera nuclear y una trabajadora del metro conformarán un equipo para detenerlos.

Dos pasajeros que viajan en hibernación a un planeta lejano despiertan, por un error técnico, 90 años antes de llegar a destino. Solos y rodeados de lujos, entre ellos surge el amor; sin embargo, descubren que hay una avería en la nave y tendrán que repararla a tiempo para salvar a las 5000 personas que permanecen hibernando, y a sí mismos.

Luego de quedar varados en un planeta hostil tras un ataque en el espacio, Kirk, Spock y el resto de la tripulación deben enfrentarse a una raza alienígena mortal mientras tratan de hallar la manera de salir de ese lugar infernal.

Roy McBride es un ingeniero que perdió a su padre en una misión sin retorno a Neptuno para encontrar signos de inteligencia extraterrestre. Veinte años después, emprende el mismo viaje a través del sistema solar para tratar de encontrarlo.
Descubra el mundo apasionado y desconocido del rodaje y todos los secretos que no se muestran en la televisión.
Vivo, un pequeño mamífero con un don especial para la música, y Gabi se embarcan en una aventura desde La Habana hasta Miami para entregarle una canción al antiguo amor de su adorado dueño.

p.t: La familia Mitchell vs. las máquinas
p.d: El viaje por carretera de la familia Mitchell, que va a acompañar a uno de sus hijos a su primer día de universidad, se ve interrumpido por una insurrección tecnológica que amenaza a la humanidad.

El señor Lobo, el señor Serpiente, el señor Piraña, el señor Tiburón y la señorita Tarántula tienen que fingir que se han convertido en chicos buenos para evitar ir a la cárcel. Conseguirlo se convierte en el mayor reto de sus carreras delictivas.

p.t: Sing 2: Ven y canta de nuevo
p.d: Buster Moon y su elenco de animales artistas se preparan para lanzar un deslumbrante espectáculo escénico en la capital mundial del entretenimiento. Solo hay un problema: debe convencer a la estrella de rock más solitaria del mundo de unirse a ellos.

Dos hermanos plomeros, Mario y Luigi, caen por las alcantarillas y llegan a un mundo subterráneo mágico en el que deben enfrentarse al malvado Bowser para rescatar a la princesa Peach, quien ha sido forzada a aceptar casarse con él.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Los agentes investigan el asesinato a golpes, ocurrido en su propia casa, de una mujer que residía en Laguna Niguel.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: La desaparición de una mujer en Lake Forest arrastra a sus vecinos y familiares a una pesadilla cuya conclusión nadie supo prever.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Los detectives se ven envueltos en un peligroso juego del gato y el ratón cuando alguien ataca brutalmente a una joven pareja en un barrio exclusivo de Placentia.
Un analista de 35 años de la NSA es apuñalado fatalmente y la policía observa a varios sospechosos. Los detectives se acercan al asesino, pero la investigación da un giro impactante.

Encuentran a una viuda de 98 años muerta en el armario de la entrada de su casa y un escalofriante descubrimiento lleva a los investigadores hasta un asesino de la comunidad que alberga un oscuro secreto.
Una adolescente es hallada asesinada a golpes en la piscina del vecindario, por lo que su padre se embarca en una misión para atrapar al asesino.
Un testigo está en el punto de mira por haber presenciado un ataque brutal. Sin embargo, cuando la policía encuentra al asesino, nada resulta ser lo que parecía.
Un magnate de los casinos es encontrado muerto en su casa por una aparente sobredosis, pero una fortuna enterrada perdida sugiere a los investigadores que podría haber más en esta historia.
Alguien asesinó a toda una familia a tiros. Las fuerzas del orden tardaron dos años en encontrar al culpable del crimen múltiple.

Asesinan salvajemente a la esposa de un rabino y los investigadores yerran cuando establecen que la motivación del crimen fue un robo. Años más tarde, algunos de los que conspiraron para asesinarla confiesan por qué lo hicieron.
Un vaquero más a gusto con los caballos que la gente desaparece en el desierto después de toparse con un grupo de ganaderos de California que creen que los ha perjudicado.

Una madre de tres hijos desaparece, y su automóvil es encontrado en una carretera desolada con una llanta sospechosamente pinchada. El caso se enfría por años hasta que un nuevo detective se hace cargo del caso y está decidido a obtener respuestas.
Los bomberos van a un incendio y encuentran tres víctimas de disparo dentro de la casa; las autoridades persiguen al asesino armado en Navidad.

Con solo 17 años, Catherine abandona su hogar en Ohio y viaja a Nueva York para cumplir el sueño de bailar en Broadway. Tres años después, la joven aparece asesinada a cuchilladas en su apartamento de Manhattan.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Los investigadores descubren sospechosos inusuales y un motivo aún más inusual después de que un vendedor de joyas local de Santa Ana desaparece y se presume que está muerto.
La Agencia guía a un fantasma hacia la luz. Mientras tanto, Susan es encontrada, pero ¿tiene salvación?

Una investigación choca con decisiones personales y profesionales cruciales. A medida que se acercan las elecciones para fiscal de distrito, los cambios en la dinámica y un incidente inesperado aumentan la urgencia y plantean interrogantes para todos los implicados.
Bex y el equipo se apresuran a capturar a Elliot Carr, un fabricante de zapatos de lujo y asesino en serie conocido como el "Zapatero de Connecticut".
En la alta sociedad parisina, Edmond se entromete en las vidas de aquellos a quienes desea destruir. Edmond se esfuerza por ocultar su identidad a Mercedes.
El retiro de composición de una estrella del pop en la costa se torna mortal. El equipo debe resolver el asesinato antes de que el asesino huya en el próximo ferry.

Jocy camina por MexaTV con una pistola en la mano, y Elena también irrumpe en un programa en vivo para hablar de Raúl. La competencia por la verdadera reina declara una ganadora, pero lo que sucede a continuación toma a todos por sorpresa.
La misión de Boyd de guiar a los residentes de regreso a casa llega a una encrucijada aterradora, y nada volverá a ser igual.

House debe diagnosticar a una joven mujer que sobrevivió al colapso de un edificio tras una explosión. La paciente solo puede comunicarse parpadeando con un ojo, y House, sin su viejo equipo, está determinado a encontrar la respuesta por su cuenta.
House trata a una paciente que sufre extrañas anomalías en la percepción. Inicia el proceso de selección de un nuevo equipo de diagnóstico entre 40 aspirantes.

House y el equipo se encargan del caso de una mujer judía que colapsa el día de su boda. House sospecha que la reciente conversión religiosa de la paciente es evidencia de una enfermedad mental, lo que ocasiona un conflicto con su esposo.

Un paciente con una excelente disposición parece tener un problema mayor del que fue diagnosticado previamente. House sospecha que la buena actitud del sujeto es un síntoma, pero el equipo difiere e intenta llegar al fondo del asunto.

House está convencido de que uno de los actores de su telenovela favorita sufre una enfermedad grave y decide intervenir en el caso, pero el actor y su equipo médico rechazan su diagnóstico, así que House decide hacerse cargo por su cuenta.

Después de que Rina resulta gravemente herida mientras se dirigía a trabajar con Jubal, el equipo hace el escalofriante descubrimiento de que un Vargas vengativo orquestó el tiroteo desde detrás de las rejas y continúa maquinando un plan.

Mientras el equipo investiga una serie de robos en joyerías que culminan en un doble asesinato, descubre una conexión con un chico de 16 años que intenta sobrevivir al sistema de protección de menores.
El equipo busca a una estudiante universitaria secuestrada. Jubal tiene un encuentro tenso con la madre de Rina.

Vicky recibe a un invitado que lleva a Latinoamérica en su alma: Luis Enrique.

Los habitantes de Nacotitlán amanecen con la noticia de que una constructora hará una carretera que pasará por su colonia, pero la arquitecta Pilar Maldonado les promete una casa nueva y una jugosa indemnización.

A los 17 años, Rina queda viuda y millonaria. Su cuñada Rafaela trama un plan para casarla con su hijo Carlos Augusto para despojarla de su fortuna.

Lety es una chica muy inteligente pero poco agraciada, más bien fea, que se graduó con honores en economía, habla varios idiomas y es una genia en las finanzas, pero por su físico no encuentra trabajo. Desesperada por encontrar empleo, acepta que la contraten por debajo de su capacidad y se emplea como secretaria en una famosa productora de videos llamada Conceptos en donde la fealdad es un tabú.

Casilda le advierte a Pablo los futuros problemas que tendrá con Paz por contarle que Melchor es su padre. Casilda le aconseja a Pablo que hable con su padre y lo perdone. Pablo le reclama a Melchor por haberle ocultado su verdadera identidad.

Los niños organizan una fiesta sorpresa para Jungle Boy, pero tienen dificultades para ocultarla del festejado.
Tim y Billy participan en la carrera de la selva y aspiran a ganar el primer premio. Tim confía en sus habilidades físicas y rechaza la ayuda, a pesar de que Paula se ofrece a entrenarlos.
El Capitán Barba Roja siente celos de la nueva amistad entre Parrot y Maurice. Les pide a los niños que lo ayuden a reavivar su amistad.
Paula y sus amigos obtienen superpoderes increíbles, excepto Billy. Sin embargo, Billy sigue decidido a aportar su granito de arena para ayudar a cumplir sus misiones.
Toby sufre una lesión después de que sus hermanos lo obliguen a realizar una patada de kung-fu. Al sentirse responsables, empiezan a tratarlo bien.
Los habitantes de Far East Village compiten por el título de "El mejor pueblo de todos los tiempos". Sin embargo, dos personas ponen en peligro sus posibilidades de ganar.
Tim y los demás niños visitan el espacio exterior y conocen por primera vez a la hija del Sr. Astronauta. Su percepción de las niñas cambia después de jugar con ella.
Astrid adopta un cachorro espacial. Se pide a los niños que la ayuden a entrenarlo antes de una competencia canina.
El Sr. Astronaut guía a los niños a través de los conceptos básicos de los vuelos espaciales. Las cosas toman un giro inesperado cuando su nave se descompone.
El Capitán Barba Roja entra en pánico al enterarse de que Parrot ha desaparecido. Los niños se unen para encontrarlo.
Astrid descubre que Cosmo, su cachorro espacial, tiene habilidades ocultas. Decide ajustar su dieta para aprovechar aún más su potencial.
Los primos del Sr. Enano de Jardín, que viven en la ciudad, lo visitan, pero no se caen bien. Los niños idean un plan para que la familia de los enanos se lleve bien.
El señor Farmer les pide a Paula y a sus amigos que cuiden a sus animales mientras él no está. Sin embargo, a los niños les cuesta satisfacer sus necesidades.
Los niños tratan de cuidar el puesto del señor Merchant mientras él no está. Sin querer, rompen algo y tienen que arreglarlo antes de que él regrese.
El príncipe Aamil descubre que su pájaro mascota se niega a volar. Los niños lo ayudan a hacerlo.
